title: Visiting Associate - 6-12 months
description:
About First Momentum Ventures

We're engineers at heart and investors by choice. That's why, what started in 2019 as a campus spin-off, we've grown into one of Europe's leading pre-seed funds, backing 50+ deeply technical startups reshaping industries from new industrials to novel computing.

With our €35M+ second fund in full swing and Fund III on the horizon, we're hiring a Visiting Associate to join our investment team and contribute to deal flow, technical evaluation, and portfolio projects.

Our aim is to be the #1 destination for deeply technical founders in Europe. We believe great teams create the future, and we're here to back them early and support them deeply. We aren't just capital providers; we invest in incredible individuals and view EQ as our greatest competitive advantage over traditional funds. The same applies to our own team: we win as a team (not individuals), believe in high agency & independence, and have every team member participate directly in the fund's economic upside.

The Role

As a Visiting Associate, you'll be a full member of our investment team with real ownership from day one and direct exposure to how the venture capital world truly operates.

This role is designed for people with 1–3 years of professional experience who want to break into the venture ecosystem and accelerate their career. It's the perfect launchpad for ambitious talent aiming to become a Chief of Staff at a leading European startup, land a full-time VC role, or start their own company down the road.

Whether you're coming from consulting, a fast-growing startup, or hold a master's degree with several internships in the startup ecosystem, we're looking for Europe's most driven young professionals to join us in building the leading pre-seed tech-focused venture fund in Europe.

Tasks

  • Find the most promising tech founders in Europe: Take the lead in sourcing high-potential pre-seed startups, running first calls independently, and developing your own conviction about which founders and ideas are truly exciting.
  • Gain full exposure to the investment process: Work side-by-side with our investment team through the entire deal flow, from first contact and due diligence to investment committee and closing. You'll play a key role in evaluating opportunities and shaping investment decisions.
  • Lead deep-dive research: Explore emerging technologies and market trends every week. Conduct sharp, data-driven analysis and present insights that influence our investment theses and strategic direction.
  • Drive impact in portfolio projects: Support our portfolio founders hands-on, from building their go-to-market motion to automating workflows with AI and optimizing operations.

Requirements

  • You have 1-3 years of work experience in the startup ecosystem, consulting, or a technical role.
  • You bring strong analytical capabilities and can move from technical papers to business models to founder conversations with ease.
  • You work with extreme ownership and high agency, spotting opportunities, designing a plan, and executing without waiting for permission.
  • You're genuinely curious about deeply technical domains. Whether you have an engineering background or just love learning how breakthrough technologies work, you're energized by technical depth.
  • You communicate clearly and convincingly in both German and English, whether you're pitching a deal to partners or giving feedback to founders.

Benefits

  • Real ownership, not busy work: You'll make independent calls on deals, lead founder conversations, support DD processes end-to-end, and help drive critical projects for our portfolio companies.
  • Technical depth you won't find elsewhere: Most of our team are engineers and scientists, which lets you develop a genuine understanding of breakthrough technologies, not just assessment skills.
  • Exceptional colleagues who challenge you: Work alongside a team that values rigorous debate, mutual support, and winning together. You'll become part of the First Momentum family, even beyond your time with us.
  • Full venture stack visibility: See everything from AI-powered sourcing to automated portfolio support. Gain the whole picture of how a leading European Deep Tech fund operates.
  • Full flexibility with a remote-first culture balanced by regular in-person gatherings across Europe.
  • Competitive pay: The compensation package will be adjusted to your professional experience and will be well above an internship salary.
  • The perfect launchpad for your next move: Whether you're heading toward a full-time VC role, a Chief of Staff position in our portfolio, or eventually starting your own venture, this position sets you up for what's next.

We're looking for candidates available for 6-12 months, starting soon or in January 2027 if preferred.

Role Overview 📝

We're looking for a Senior or Staff ML / Operations Research Engineer to take on some of the hardest problems at HIVED: the planning systems that decide how every parcel moves through our 100% electric delivery network.

You'll join the Routing Squad, which owns HIVED's entire planning pipeline: demand forecasting, capacity planning and scheduling, sortation, our collections network and large-scale route optimisation. The problems are as varied as they are hard. How much volume will each depot see next week, and how many drivers and vehicles do we need to meet it? description:
Senior Engineer II - EngEx & AI Engineer

● Location: UK Hybrid

● Level: TL1

● Team: Engineering Experience & AI Foundations

This role is based in the UK and requires an existing right to work in the UK.

At this time, we are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role. We are committed to building a diverse, global team and our sponsorship policy is evaluated on a role-by-role basis. We encourage you to keep an eye on our careers site to stay informed about future opportunities where we are able to offer visa sponsorship.

Kaluza Overview

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

What will I be doing?

You'll join the Engineering Experience & AI Foundations team within our broader Kaluza Technology community. Your work will directly impact how Kaluza scales productivity safely and with high quality, and defines the gold standard for Agentic Software Development in the organisation.

As a Senior II Engineer, you'll help set the technical direction for our Internal AI Engineering Platform and the Kaluza Agentic SDLC Framework (KASF). You'll design and implement the infrastructure, from Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers to shared agentic workflows, and use your influence across teams to make it the way Kaluza builds software. In 2027, our goal is org wide adoption of KASF across engineering, and you'll be a technical owner of getting there safely, securely and with measurable impact on quality and velocity.

  • Technical Direction & Architecture: Drive the architecture and technical roadmap for our EngEx & AI Platform Foundations team, including the Kaluza AI Control Plane (KAIC), the AI governance layer (MCP and LLM gateways), and shared Agents, Skills, Workflows and Standards. Shape and document build-vs-buy decisions and balance fast-moving vendor capabilities against long-term platform stability.

  • Hands-On Delivery: Stay close to the implementation. Design, build and ship core platform components, set the engineering bar through your own code, and prototype new approaches to prove them before the team scales them.


  • Agentic SDLC (KASF) Adoption: Drive KASF from early adoption to all engineering teams during 2027. Oversee creation and evolution of reference architectures, standards and adoption playbooks, work with engineering leaders to embed KASF in how teams plan, build, review and ship, and use feedback and metrics to remove blockers.

  • AI Tooling Evaluation & Deployment: Lead structured, time-boxed trials of emerging engineering tools with clear success criteria and go/no-go recommendations. Keep Kaluza at the forefront of the AI space while retiring tools that don't earn their place.

  • Governance, Security & Risk: Act as the technical authority on AI risk for engineering. Work with Security, Legal and Data Protection to design approval processes and guardrails (data leakage, prompt injection, model access) that protect the business without slowing innovation.

  • Champion Engineering Experience: Support the definition and evolution of engineering experience at Kaluza and enable our engineers to do more. Drawing on established frameworks such as DORA and SPACE alongside integrated tooling to surface trends, feedback and points of friction to drive improvements and optimisations across the organisation. Evolve our understanding and assessment of AI Metrics and their impact on outcomes.

  • Cost Optimisation: Partner with Finance and Security to keep AI usage secure and cost-efficient at scale, including guardrails and unit economics for model spend.

  • Technical Leadership: Mentor Senior and mid-level engineers, lead design reviews, and raise the technical standard of the team and the wider engineering community. Influence senior stakeholders across disciplines, turn ambiguous problems into clear plans, and build a network of AI champions in engineering teams. Pragmatic and open-minded and able to see things from different perspectives with both technical and non-technical cohorts.

About You

Ideally you'll have/be:

  • Technical Leadership Experience: A substantial engineering background, with a track record of leading technical direction on platform, infrastructure or developer-experience work, and still hands-on in the code.

  • Production-Grade AI Implementation: Experience building and running production systems, ideally including LLM-based or agentic systems, and a deep interest in the "LLM-ops" lifecycle beyond chat interfaces, including evaluation, observability and reliability. Ideally experience across multiple model providers and multi-agent systems.

  • Systems Thinker: Strong distributed systems foundations and the judgement to integrate third-party AI APIs (Claude, OpenAI and others) without compromising reliability or latency.

  • Full-Stack Experience: You have hands-on experience across the stack and know what good looks like. Ideally you have experience with AWS in production, and you treat AI prompts, MCP configurations, and agent definitions with the same version-control rigor as your infrastructure.

  • The EngEx Mindset: You are passionate about engineer productivity. You don’t just build tools; you build experiences that make an engineer's day-to-day life easier and more creative. Supportive and empathetic towards others and able to make connections between symptoms and underlying causes.

  • Security & Governance First: You understand AI risks such as data leakage and prompt injection, and can design guardrails and approval processes that protect the business without slowing it down.

  • Data-Informed: You define success measures up front, automate the metrics AI-generated code volume, PR velocity, adoption), and change course when the data says so.

  • Influence & Communication: You can bring senior stakeholders and sceptical teams with you, and translate complex AI concepts into clear guides, onboarding docs and shared best practice.

  • Collaboration: You are a strong communicator who can translate complex AI concepts into clear guides, onboarding docs, and shared best practices for the wider engineering. community. Consideration for different audiences, including non-technical, being friendly, approachable and non-judgemental are key.

  • Curiosity & Judgement: The AI landscape changes weekly. You enjoy trialling new tools, and you have the judgement to pivot, or to say no, when a better option emerges.

Our Values

Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:

  • Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

  • Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.

Our Perks

  • Time off and family: 26 days’ holiday, plus 26 weeks’ full pay for new parents with no qualifying service period

  • Health and security: Private medical insurance with virtual GP, life assurance, pension scheme, free mortgage advice and eye tests

  • Pay and flexibility: Discretionary bonus, a Flex Fund of 5% [of salary] to spend on the benefits you want most, retail discounts through Perks at Work

  • Growth and setup: Personal learning budget, home office budget

  • Climate: Furthr, our climate action app

Come as you are

We want to meet people from all walks of life. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, and we recognise talent on merit and potential. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you.

title: Network Production Engineer
description:
About Fluidstack

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.


We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

How We Operate

  • Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

  • Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

  • Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

  • Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

  • Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

The Production Engineering Team

Examples of key problems the team is working on

  • Turn every network fault from a mystery into a closed ticket. Link diagnostics across router to router and NIC to router paths, remote command execution across the fleet, and repair visualization that shows what's broken and why, because at 10s of GW scale debugging has to be systematic, not artisanal.

  • Build the network repair pipeline that runs itself. Automated fault detection through RMA initiation, ticket integration, transceiver lifecycle tracking, and return to service, across DC fabric, edge, and host to network layers, because a new site comes online every six months and manual repair doesn't keep up.

  • Build the network monitoring platform for a fleet that never stops growing. Alerting lifecycle and health dashboards for infrastructure spanning multiple hyperscale sites today and 10s of GW next year. It doesn't exist yet. We're building it.

Role Scope

  • Carry the on-call pager for the network fleet and run repair end to end: diagnose the fault, execute the fix or drive the RMA, and return the link to service across DC fabric, edge, and host to network layers.

  • Write Python and Go tooling that replaces manual diagnosis, including link tests, remote command execution across the fleet, and repair visualization that shows what's broken and why, so faults resolve in minutes, not hours.

  • Automate the repair pipeline from fault detection through RMA initiation, ticket integration, transceiver and optics tracking, and return to service, so a failure at any site follows the same path without manual handoffs.

  • Maintain the realtime monitoring and alerting that gives every on-call engineer a true picture of network health across all sites, and keep it accurate as new sites and hardware roll in.

  • Validate new sites and hardware into production by running the qualification tests that confirm a network is healthy before it carries traffic.

What We're Looking For

The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly, tell us where you would.

  • You've carried a pager for a production network and can walk into an outage, find the fault, fix it or drive the RMA, and write the postmortem without someone walking you through it.

  • You've written Python or Go scripts that replaced a manual, repetitive network task, from link diagnostics to config pushes to fleet-wide command execution.

  • You understand how a transceiver fault, a misconfigured route, and a power event each show up differently in the data, and you can tell them apart from the signals alone.

  • You've worked hands-on with link diagnostics, optics, and network monitoring protocols such as gNMI, gRPC, NETCONF, and SONiC, and you're comfortable at the CLI on switches and routers across a fleet.

  • You treat toil as a bug. If a repair step means SSHing into ten boxes by hand, you script it once and never do it by hand again.

  • You reach real competence in an unfamiliar part of the stack fast, and you document what you learn so the next on-call engineer doesn't start from zero.

  • Bonus: RMA and repair lifecycle automation. Large-scale datacenter fabric (BGP, ECMP, spine-leaf). Out-of-band network management. Fluency with AI coding tools such as Claude Code or Cursor to move faster on scripts and tooling.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
About Cinder

Cinder is the mission-critical infrastructure that keeps the world's most important digital platforms true to what they stand for. The internet has always been abused by bad actors, and AI is making it exponentially worse, driving fraud, abuse, and manipulation at a scale and speed no human team can fight alone. Cinder gives platforms one command center to fight back: to write and enforce policy, deploy AI agents against abuse in real time, investigate threats, file NCMEC reports, and prove their safety programs are working.

Our customers are some of the largest internet platforms in the world. The decisions made in our software directly determine what stays up, what comes down, and how users are treated.

We're a small, fast-moving team backed by Accel and Y Combinator. We care about being intentional, direct, and deeply focused on solving real customer problems.

Why this role

Once a deal closes, you're the technical owner on the ground. You're the escalation point for the customer, working closely with their CSM and Agent Product Manager (agent PM), and the first line of engineering defense when something isn't working the way they expect.

For some customers, "close" means embedded. You're effectively part of their engineering team, in their Slack, on their calls, building alongside them. The platforms you'd be embedded with have hundreds of millions of users between them. When you fix something, it's not hypothetical. It's live, that day.

What you'd actually work on

  • Shape and prove the solution. Work directly with customers to understand their problems, identify the right use cases, and build proofs of concept that demonstrate value and de-risk the path to production.

  • Own deployments end to end. Take the technical work from scoping and system design through implementation, rollout, and adoption — partnering with the CSM while owning the engineering plan.

  • Build the last mile. Connect Cinder to each customer’s stack through APIs, webhooks, data pipelines, custom workflows, and production-quality code where configuration isn’t enough.

  • Enable customer teams. Run technical workshops, document what you build, and give customers the knowledge and tools to operate successfully without us in the room.

  • Turn fieldwork into product leverage. Solve issues in the systems you ship, identify patterns across customers, and turn those lessons into reusable tools and improvements to the core product. Own on-call for customers when system downtime means moderation stops.

What we're looking for

  • 4-8 years as a software engineer, solutions engineer, or in a similar role in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

  • Solid Python fundamentals. You can read, debug, and extend backend code without hand-holding. Comfortability with SQL, Typescript, React, and GraphQL.

  • Real experience owning implementation, not just scoping it. You've configured or customized a product for a specific customer and shipped something that changed what that customer could actually do.

  • You are exceptionally comfortable with ambiguity and repeatedly take initiative — you thrive when dropped into unfamiliar situations, learning quickly, and finding ways to deliver value.

  • No degree requirement. We care about what you can build, not where you learned to build it. Bootcamp grads are welcome.

Nice to have

  • Understanding of trust & safety or safety operations, either firsthand (you've worked in it) or through a specialized background — a T&S-focused master's, for example — that gives you real fluency, not just familiarity.

  • Consulting experience where you turned a client's ambiguous ask into a working solution.

  • Familiarity with React Query or Strawberry specifically.

  • Experience being embedded with a customer or client team, rather than working at arm's length through tickets.

Location & Benefits

Our team is based in London and we believe that in-person collaboration is important. We offer medical and dental insurance benefits through Allianz Global. We hold at least two all-company events per year. We offer paid lunch when our team is in-person.

About H:

Our agents act on computers for our customers, clicking through software and filling in fields, so our contracts have to answer some awkward questions. Who owns what an agent produces? Who answers when an output turns out to be wrong? Can customer data train our models? Our terms already take a position on all three, and they're public: read our general terms of service and our data processing agreement, both in French, under French law, and last updated in June 2026. This job is drafting and negotiating contracts like these, and keeping them current as the product and the law move.

H builds computer-use agents for enterprises, from Paris. In July 2026 we launched Computer-use Agents, fully managed agents that take actions on computers.

What you own

Our business teams bring in the deals. You'd write the paper behind them and lead the negotiation. When AI regulation or data protection law changes, you'd help work out what our contracts need to say now. You'd report to Julie Martinez, our General Counsel, who is also the data protection officer named in our DPA.

What you'd be doing

  • Drafting and advising on a wide range of contracts, AI service agreements among them, with customers, partners and suppliers.

  • Working through the other side's mark-up. Our general terms cap our liability on paid services at the higher of €100 or the previous 12 months' fees, for example. When a customer's lawyers push on it, you'd work out where we hold. Then you'd make the argument.

  • Turning new products and new AI law into contract changes and negotiation guidance. What we ship includes open-weight models: Holo3-35B-A3B is on Hugging Face under Apache 2.0, fine-tuned from Qwen3.5-35B-A3B.

  • Answering engineers and business teams on how to deploy AI within the rules. Customers can see on our Trust Center that we hold ISO 27001:2022, SOC 2 Type 1 and SOC 2 Type 2, and which subprocessors we use.

  • When needed, questions outside contracts: employment, corporate or competition law.

Who you'd work with

Julie Martinez, our General Counsel, is hiring for this role. You'd join our Legal team and work closely with engineers and business teams.

What we think it takes

Likely a good fit if you

  • Hold a master's in law and are admitted to the bar.

  • Have a minimum of 3 to 5 years of relevant legal experience.

  • Know data protection law well (GDPR and the rules around it), along with IP, contract law and liability, and regulatory compliance.

  • Have worked somewhere that was growing fast.

  • Can explain a legal position plainly to an engineer. Work well on your own and adapt when plans change. An international outlook matters here too.

Stronger still if you built that experience negotiating contracts at a tech or AI company.

You do not need to have worked at an AI company before. If you match most of this but not all of it, apply anyway.

How we hire

Three conversations. First a 30 minute call with our Talent team, then 30 minutes with Julie, and last a conversation with a member of our leadership team.

Practicalities

It's a hybrid job: you'd be in Paris with the team for three days in an average week. We offer a competitive package.

description:
About HappyRobot

HappyRobot is the infrastructure for enterprises to build and orchestrate AI workforces. Our AI workers don't just communicate through voice and email - they make decisions, take action, and run operations autonomously across entire enterprise systems. We started in logistics, built our own voice stack, models, and orchestration layer from the ground up, and are now bringing that infrastructure to every enterprise that runs the real economy. Learn more about our vision in our manifesto.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Application Security Engineer to help secure our product and platform through hands-on security architecture and engineering. You’ll work closely with product, engineering, and compliance teams, taking ownership from identifying risks through designing, implementing, and rolling out solutions.

We’re a lean security team, so your work will span security reviews, vulnerability management, platform hardening, automation, incident response, and compliance engineering. Alongside finding and fixing vulnerabilities, you’ll identify opportunities to prevent entire classes of risks through shared security controls and centralized enforcement. You’ll help decide where these investments matter most and build solutions that teams can adopt as the company grows.

What You’ll Do

  • Design and implement shared security controls that prevent entire classes of vulnerabilities and centralize enforcement across applications and services.

  • Partner with engineers on architecture and threat modeling, translating risks into concrete designs for authorization, service identity, tenant isolation, and data protection.

  • Build security controls and secure defaults into application frameworks, service templates, and infrastructure modules, making them straightforward for teams to adopt.

  • Develop automation that connects security tools with engineering workflows, adds context to findings, and automates remediation where appropriate.

  • Own vulnerability management across internal findings, automated tooling, external assessments, and researcher reports.

  • Review code, perform targeted security testing, and manage vulnerabilities through verified remediation. Use recurring findings to identify where a shared control or architectural change would prevent similar issues.

  • Support the compliance team by implementing technical controls, automating procedures, and validating that controls operate as intended.

  • Help investigate security incidents and use the findings to improve architecture, controls, and detection.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in application security, product security, or software engineering with substantial security ownership.

  • Strong understanding of web, API, and distributed-system security, including authentication, authorization, tenant isolation, and sensitive data handling.

  • Experience taking security controls from architectural design through implementation and adoption across multiple services or teams.

  • Ability to design defense in depth, establish clear trust boundaries, and limit the impact of compromised components or credentials.

  • Strong coding skills: you can review production code, contribute fixes, and build maintainable tooling and shared security components.

  • Experience integrating security tools into engineering workflows and using context and automation to reduce manual work.

  • Sound technical judgment, clear communication, and the independence to take an ambiguous problem through to a working solution.

Why join us?

  • Work closely with engineers building AI systems used in critical enterprise operations.

  • Own substantial security projects and help shape a growing security program.

  • Have the autonomy to design solutions, implement them, and see their impact in production.

  • Join a company backed by leading investors.

  • Competitive salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits.

Our Operating Principles


Extreme Ownership

We take full responsibility for our work, outcomes, and team success. No excuses, no blame-shifting — if something needs fixing, we own it and make it better. This means stepping up, even when it’s not “your job.” If a ball is dropped, we pick it up. If a customer is unhappy, we fix it. If a process is broken, we redesign it. We don’t wait for someone else to solve it — we lead with accountability and expect the same from those around us.

 

Craftsmanship

Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. Craftsmanship means never settling for “just fine.” We sweat the details because details compound. Whether it’s a product feature, an internal doc, or a sales call — we treat it as a reflection of our standards. We aim to deliver jaw-dropping customer experiences by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build — even when nobody’s watching.

 

We are “majos”
Be friendly & have fun with your coworkers. Always be genuine & honest, but kind. “Majo” is our way of saying: be a good human. Be approachable, helpful, and warm. We’re building something ambitious, and it’s easier (and more fun) when we enjoy the ride together. We give feedback with kindness, challenge each other with respect, and celebrate wins together without ego.

 

Urgency with Focus
Create the highest impact in the shortest amount of time. Move fast, but in the right direction. We operate with speed because time is our most limited resource. But speed without focus is chaos. We prioritize ruthlessly, act decisively, and stay aligned. We aim for high leverage: the biggest results from the simplest, smartest actions. We’re running a high-speed marathon — not a sprint with no strategy.

 

Talent Density and Meritocracy
Hire only people who can raise the average; ‘exceptional performance is the passing grade.’ Ability trumps seniority. We believe the best teams are built on talent density — every hire should raise the bar. We reward contribution, not titles or tenure. We give ownership to those who earn it, and we all hold each other to a high standard. A-players want to work with other A-players — that’s how we win.

 

First-Principles Thinking
Strip a problem to physics-level facts, ignore industry dogma, rebuild the solution from scratch. We don’t copy-paste solutions. We go back to basics, ask why things are the way they are, and rebuild from the ground up if needed. This mindset pushes us to innovate, challenge stale assumptions, and move faster than incumbents. It’s how we build what others think is impossible.

title: Post-doctorant(e) en IA agentique correcte par construction (SoS)  - CDD de 12 mois
description:
Qui sommes-nous ?

Télécom Paris, école de l’IMT (Institut Mines-Télécom) et membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris, est une grande école du top 6 des écoles d’ingénieurs généralistes françaises.

La Raison d’Être de Télécom Paris est de former, imaginer et entreprendre pour concevoir des modèles, des technologies et des solutions numériques au service d’une société et d’une économie respectueuses de l’humain et de son environnement.

Nous recherchons notre futur(e) post-doctorant(e) en IA agentique correcte par construction (SoS) pour rejoindre le département INFRES de Télécom Paris.

Contexte scientifique :

les cadres de vérification existants supposent généralement des modèles finis et précisément définis, dont les actions et les relations de transition sont connues. Ces hypothèses sont difficiles à maintenir dans les systèmes modernes d’IA agentique, où les actions peuvent être générées dynamiquement, les environnements peuvent évoluer et les informations sur le système peuvent être incomplètes.

Le projet Sound or Silent (SoS) vise à combler cette lacune en étudiant une nouvelle approche d’IA agentique correcte par construction. L’idée centrale consiste à intégrer le raisonnement stratégique et la vérification formelle directement au processus décisionnel des agents autonomes. Au lieu de vérifier un agent uniquement après son développement ou de surveiller son comportement après l’exécution, SoS étudie la possibilité de produire des actions formellement certifiées conformes à une spécification donnée. Selon cette approche, une action candidate n’est exécutée que s’il est établi qu’elle appartient à une stratégie garantissant les propriétés requises. Si une telle garantie ne peut être établie, l’agent s’abstient d’agir.

Atteindre cet objectif exige d’étendre les techniques de vérification stratégique à des environnements ouverts, évolutifs et partiellement spécifiés, et d’étudier des notions de correction adaptées à une information incomplète. Le projet explorera également une architecture associant un composant génératif non fiable, chargé de proposer des actions ou des stratégies candidates, à un noyau de vérification formelle de confiance, chargé d’en contrôler la correction. Une attention particulière sera portée à l’expressivité des modèles formels sous-jacents, au coût de calcul de la certification et au compromis entre garanties formelles et capacité des agents à accomplir des tâches utiles.

Les travaux associeront des développements théoriques à la réalisation et à l’évaluation expérimentale de prototypes, dans des scénarios de planification autonome, d’agents d’IA utilisant des outils et de coordination multi-agents. L’objectif général est de poser les fondements de systèmes d’IA agentique dont l’autonomie est encadrée par des garanties stratégiques formellement vérifiables.

Vos missions principales seront de :

  • Mener des travaux de recherche sur l’IA agentique correcte par construction

  • Assurer des missions d’encadrement et de tutorat

  • Contribuer au rayonnement scientifique de Télécom Paris


Vous devrez être titulaire d’un doctorat ou d’un diplôme équivalent et disposer de solides connaissances en méthodes formelles, logique et vérification de modèles. Une expérience dans les systèmes multi-agents, les logiques stratégiques, la vérification à l’exécution ainsi que dans le développement d’agents fondés sur les grands modèles de langage (LLM) sera également attendue.

Vous devrez maîtriser le développement logiciel et l’implémentation d’algorithmes, ainsi que la démarche de recherche scientifique, notamment la formulation de problématiques, la conception d’expériences et l’analyse de leurs résultats. Une excellente maîtrise de l’anglais, à l’écrit comme à l’oral, sera indispensable.

Enfin, vous devrez faire preuve d’un bon esprit d’équipe, de qualités relationnelles et pédagogiques, de bonnes capacités rédactionnelles ainsi que d’un esprit de synthèse.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

Vous travaillerez dans un environnement en plein développement, agréable, verdoyant et accessible (notamment pour les personnes en situation de handicap) à seulement 20 km de Paris (RER B et C, proximité des grands axes routiers).

title: Automation Engineer – Magnet Industrialisation
description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

TEAM & ROLE

  • Architect a breakthrough energy technology – Play a defining role in designing and integrating the systems that will power the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion plant, influencing decisions that shape the future of clean energy.

  • Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges in fusion – Work across magnet design, HTS technology, manufacturing, structural integration, and controls, turning cutting-edge science into real hardware

  • Move fast and build what matters – Join a highly ambitious, multidisciplinary team that combines cutting-edge simulation with hands-on engineering, turning bold ideas into real hardware on the path to commercial fusion.

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

  • You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world.

  • You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals.

  • Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey.

  • Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent.

YOUR IMPACT

You will support the industrialisation of production processes for magnet production, contributing directly to the execution of key activities within Proxima’s magnet program.

You will play a central role in designing, programming and operating automation cells performing a wide array of production processes such as welding, bonding, sealing and coating.

You will operate across a wide range of technical tasks, from design and engineering to hands on production work, and collaborating closely with engineers and technicians

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Advise on future line design and automation concepts

  • Define the requirements for automation cells for different processes to ensure performance, repeatability and safe operation

  • Contribute to the development of control strategies for new production lines

  • You will build and commission automation cells, including running FAT at supplier sites

  • Identify and test different manufacturing and in-process monitoring approaches

  • Design jigs and tools for magnet industrialised production

  • Support in the process development and prototyping of magnets, with scalability and repeatability in mind.

  • Collaborate closely with engineers and technicians across multiple teams

WHO YOU ARE

  • A master´s degree in mechanical, mechatronics or similar engineering field

  • A wide experience in robotics, automation and process monitoring in an industrial setting

  • Strong hands-on experience in production environments over a wide range of production processes (for ex. welding, machining, assembly, bonding)

  • Experience with robotic simulation and offline programming (e.g. RoboGuide, RobotStudio, Process Simulate). Previous work on FANUC systems is a plus

  • Familiarity with industrial communication protocols (e.g., OPC UA, Ethernet, Profinet)

  • Proficient in industrial-level PLC programming

  • Ability to work across a variety of tasks in a dynamic environment

  • Reliable, proactive, and solution-oriented mindset

  • Strong team player, able to collaborate closely with engineers and technical staff

  • A high performer who loves challenges and is not afraid to experiment, take risks and learn from mistakes.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Familiarity in both prototype manufacturing and industrial manufacturing

  • Proficiency in CAD: good knowledge of Catia V5 or 3DExperience are considered as a plus

  • Exposure to SCADA systems or MES integration

  • Familiarity with Beckhoff PLC and motion control

  • Knowledge of safety standards and risk assessments in automated environments

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

  • Technical Panel (3x60 min)

title: Senior Backend Developer
description:
Payroll that runs itself. You build the part that runs it.

quinn is an app-based managed payroll and employment-administration service for households and companies who employ people directly. The customer stays the legal employer. quinn registers the employment, runs payroll, pays salaries, social insurance and taxes, and handles every filing that follows, on their behalf and automated end to end.

We don’t sell payroll software. We run payroll.

We operate in Switzerland, Germany and the UK. Last year more than CHF 200 million in salaries ran through our systems, correct to the cent. The purpose behind it is simple: fair employment, for all.

Why this role exists

Every market brings its own authorities, insurers, pension funds and tax rules. Our answer is quinn ONE: one platform for every product and market, with a shared core for what all countries have in common and a configuration layer per country on top, designed to carry twelve countries.

The backend is that core. It is a modular monolith in C#, .NET 10 and PostgreSQL, serving one quinn app for employers, employees and our own support team, Maestro for batch processing, and our AI agents. Development has started, and the foundations the platform will run on for years are being laid now.

This role is fully focused on quinn ONE. Our existing products are not part of it.

What you will own

  • Backend modules, end to end. Design, build, test and run modules and the APIs they expose, from requirements to production, without waiting to be handed a ticket.

  • The data. The PostgreSQL model the platform rests on: schema design, migrations, transactions, indexing, and the calculations that must be right to the cent.

  • The foundations. Audit trail, logging, versioning of our APIs and services, and the database upgrades that keep the platform current.

  • Reliability and security in production. Tests, observability, performance, and data protection by design: an API returns what is needed, not everything that is available. Root causes, not symptoms.

  • The architecture, pragmatically. Module boundaries, dependencies, the shared core and the country layers, evolved with clear trade-offs rather than fashionable patterns.

  • The engineering bar. Code review, design discussions, and mentoring the developers around you, in Zurich and in our Armenia team.

Where the frontend ends, the backend begins. Our Product Frontend Engineer owns everything on the screen: the app, Maestro’s interface, the component library. You own everything behind it: the domain model, the payroll logic, the APIs, the integrations with authorities, insurers and banks, and the data. You agree the API contract together, and Product decides what gets built.

How we work

We are AI-native, operationally rather than as a slogan. AI is how a small team ships like a large one, and how one engineer can hold the standard described here.

We expect you to live in these tools and build your own leverage with them: scaffolding, test generation, migration checks, and whatever else takes manual work out of the way.

And we expect the judgement that comes with it. AI writes code that looks right and is subtly wrong: a transaction boundary in the wrong place, a migration that works on test data and locks a table in production. In payroll, an amount is either right or wrong. You take the speed and keep the standard.

Your first year

In your first month, you set up, learn the system and the people, and merge your first changes. Within 100 days, you have delivered the platform’s audit trail, tested and documented, and fixed the first risks you spotted on arrival.

By month nine, you are the person the team turns to for the quinn backend, and a developer you mentored is delivering features on their own. By the end of the year, the major backend roadmap items are live (logging, the database upgrade, versioning for our APIs and services), and at least one standard you introduced is used beyond your own team.

Who we are looking for

  • You have shipped and run production systems in C# and modern .NET / ASP.NET Core, and you know how they behave under load.

  • You know PostgreSQL properly: schema design, transactions, locking, indexing and query optimisation. You read the execution plan before you add a cache.

  • You have designed APIs and modules with clear boundaries and manageable dependencies.

  • You treat personal and financial data with care. Security is part of how you design, not a review at the end.

  • You use AI tools every day, and you can show where they made you faster and where you caught them being wrong.

  • You own initiatives independently and raise risks before they become surprises.

  • You review constructively, mentor willingly, and write code others can take over.

  • English is your working language. German is a plus.

What makes you stand out

  • You have worked where an amount is either right or wrong: payroll, banking, insurance, accounting or tax.

  • You have built foundations others relied on for years: an audit trail, observability, API versioning, a data model.

  • You have taken a major database upgrade or migration through production without drama.

  • You can explain what you built, why you chose your approach, and what changed because of it.

The team

We are a small, fast and direct team: engineers in Zurich working closely with our Armenia team, and colleagues across Switzerland, Germany and the UK, 40 people in all. Not much process, not much hierarchy. A clear strategy, an ambitious plan, and five values we mean: be open, own it, speak up, keep it simple, bias for action.

We are not filling a seat. If you would rather build the core than maintain the plumbing, we would like to hear from you.

The facts

  • Location: Zürich Wiedikon, hybrid with three days a week in the office; occasional travel to the UK, Germany and our Armenia team

  • Role: Senior Backend Developer, individual contributor with technical leadership

  • Reporting line: Our Lead Engineers

  • Stack: C#, .NET 10, PostgreSQL; modular monolith

  • Pensum: 100%

  • Start: As soon as possible

  • Language: English; German a plus

  • Process: A 20–30 minute screening call, an in-person interview in Zürich on your career so far, a focused technical interview with the team (where we may work through a real quinn problem together), and reference calls

How to apply

Apply with your CV and two short paragraphs: why this role, and why now. If you have something you shipped and are proud of, a system, a module or a write-up of a hard problem, include it. It tells us more than a CV does.

title: Research Engineer, Foundation Model (Multimodal Fusion & Distillation)
description:
Our Mission

At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient.

We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today!

The Role

You will build the parts of LEA, our foundation model of the physical world, where field data is the input. LEA takes in cameras, infrared, thermal, lidar and robot state natively, around the clock, on real security sites. We stand on the best open models for the encoders and the reasoning head and do not pretrain from scratch. Your work goes where nobody else can do it: fusing every sensor into one stream, teaching an open vision-language model to reason over that stream, and distilling a fast model that sees every frame.

This is the first engineer dedicated to the model track, so you will also set how we train, evaluate and ship models. You will work with our Command Centre and Robot Autonomy teams to get what you train running on site appliances and robots, and you will see it tested at 03:00 in the rain.

What You'll Work On

  • Native encoders: adapt the best open vision and point-cloud foundation models to RGB, IR, thermal and lidar, one encoder per sensor, raw stream in.

  • Fusion: build the layer that aligns every sensor in time and space into one token stream, trained on time-aligned multi-sensor field data that exists nowhere else.

  • Slow head: fine-tune an open frontier vision-language model to reason over fused sensor tokens instead of pictures.

  • Fast head: distil a small model from the slow head's calls on our own events, so every frame is seen and only hard cases escalate.

  • Evaluation: held-out sites, night and thermal slices, regression gates. A model that is worse anywhere does not ship.

  • Training machinery: multi-GPU training, data loaders for multi-sensor clips, experiment tracking and reproducible runs.

Who We're Looking For

A research engineer who has shipped multimodal models, not only published them. You know when an open model is good enough and when to build, you measure on the slice that matters before claiming a number, and you care whether the model works on a real site, not only on a benchmark.

Your Background

  • 4+ years training and fine-tuning large vision or multimodal models, or a PhD plus industry experience.

  • Strong PyTorch, comfortable with multi-GPU and multi-node training.

  • Hands-on fine-tuning of vision-language models (instruction tuning, parameter-efficient methods, full fine-tunes).

  • Experience with knowledge distillation or model compression for deployment.

  • Work with video or non-RGB sensors: thermal, infrared, lidar or radar.

  • Evaluation discipline and solid software engineering hygiene.

Nice to Have

  • Point-cloud or 3D foundation models.

  • Self-supervised and latent-prediction methods (JEPA-style).

  • Edge deployment with TensorRT or similar.

  • Robotics or field data collection.

  • Publications at top ML, vision or robotics venues.

What We Offer

  • Ownership: you are able to ship products and deliver project end-to-end.

  • Mission: autonomous security that keeps people and critical sites safe, including in defence.

  • Career path: a ground-floor seat with real runway. Prove your value and you will not have barriers to grow.

title: hbo-stage Analyseren kwaliteit bouwvergunningen BAG
description:
hbo-afstudeerstage, vanaf februari 2027

Ben jij die nieuwsgierige en enthousiaste student die graag in data duikt en op zoek gaat naar opvallende patronen en verbanden?
Krijg jij energie van het ontrafelen van complexe vraagstukken, het ontdekken van inzichten en het vertalen van data naar betekenisvolle resultaten?

Dit is jouw uitdaging

Het CBS ontvangt maandelijks van de 342 gemeenten in Nederland informatie over verleende bouwvergunningen. Gemeenten leveren deze gegevens aan via enquêtes en registreren de bouwvergunningen daarnaast in de Basisregistratie Adressen en Gebouwen (BAG).

Sinds 2025 publiceert het CBS de cijfers over bouwvergunningen op basis van de BAG. Er is echter een groot en toenemend verschil tussen de cijfers uit de BAG en de tellingen uit de enquêtes. Er is reeds onderzoek gedaan naar deze toenemende verschillen.

Als stagiair ga je dit verder onderzoeken, door middel van een diepgaande analyse van de tijdigheid en kwaliteit van de registratie van gegevens in de BAG. Daarnaast verzamel je informatie over het registratieproces om beter inzicht te krijgen in hoe de BAG zich verhoudt tot de werkelijkheid.

Je onderzoekt onder andere:

  • Hoe lang wachten gemeenten met registraties?

  • Worden registraties doorlopend geregistreerd, of opgespaard en in korte tijd geregistreerd in de BAG?

  • Verandert de kwaliteit en tijdigheid door de tijd heen?

Om deze vragen te beantwoorden duik je in een grote database, waar je met behulp van SQL en R of Python trends gaat waarnemen, data visualiseert, en samenvattingen maakt.

Daarnaast verzamel je informatie over het registratieproces, en hoe dit is geïmplementeerd bij gemeenten. Voor deze taak is al eerder onderzoek gedaan, en is er ook al meer informatie beschikbaar. Je verzamelt deze resultaten in een rapport met een overzicht van de huidige stand van zaken.

Dit is jouw stageplek bij CBS Den Haag

Ons team bestaat uit 24 enthousiaste collega’s, die met veel passie en plezier werken aan statistische informatie over vastgoed en de woningmarkt.

We maken statistieken over (bouw)vergunningen, ontwikkeling van de woningvoorraad, (gemiddelde) WOZ-waardes, eigendomsverhoudingen, tijdelijke woningen, woningtransformaties en nog heel veel meer. We doen statistisch onderzoek op verzoek van organisaties in de publieke sector. En we beheren en verwerken data voor CBS-collega’s en werken samen met diverse organisaties, waaronder het Kadaster, de ministeries van BZK, VRO en EZK en Eurostat.

We publiceren regelmatig over de dynamiek van de Nederlandse vastgoed- en woningmarkt. Onze nieuwsberichten halen regelmatig journaals, nieuwssites en voorpagina’s van landelijke dagbladen. En daar zijn we trots op!

Dit breng jij mee

Je volgt een hbo opleiding in de studierichting toegepaste wiskunde, data science of sociale wetenschappen.

  • Je hebt affiniteit met de woningmarkt.

  • Je hebt kennis en wellicht ervaring met R/rmarkdown en/of Python en SQL databases. 

  • Je bent nieuwsgierig, leergierig en enthousiast om met data aan de slag te gaan.

  • Je vindt het leuk om nieuwe dingen te ontdekken, neemt graag initiatief en denkt actief mee.

  • Je kunt zelfstandig werken, maar zoekt ook graag de samenwerking op.

  • Je deelt gemakkelijk je ideeën en bevindingen en staat open voor nieuwe inzichten en feedback.

Omdat tijdens de stage alle communicatie – zowel mondeling als schriftelijk – in het Nederlands plaatsvindt, is een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal noodzakelijk.

Dit kun je van ons verwachten

Een fijne leeromgeving waarin je:

  • samenwerkt met ervaren experts binnen hun vakgebied;

  • gaat werken met grote databases (SQL);

  • kennis opbouwt van de BAG en het registratieproces bij bronhouders;

  • analyses samenvat in data visualisaties en overzichtelijke tabellen.

Voor jouw inzet ontvang je een stagevergoeding van € 800,- bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur per week).

Samen met je stagebegeleider stem je af hoe je hybride kunt werken, met flexibele werktijden en de optie om deels vanuit huis aan jouw stageopdracht te werken.

Dit zijn onze voorwaarden

Het betreft een stageopdracht en geen werkervaringsplek. Voordat je aan de stage begint verwachten we dat je vanuit de onderwijsinstelling een stagebegeleider hebt, waarmee de stage is afgestemd en concrete leerdoelen zijn afgesproken.
Deze stageopdracht is bedoeld voor studenten die momenteel staan ingeschreven bij een onderwijsinstelling; afgestudeerden komen niet in aanmerking.

title: Senior Customer Success Manager (with Ed-Tech experience)
description:
Are you passionate about transforming how large organizations learn and develop? Imagine being the trusted advisor to some of the world's most prestigious brands, guiding them through learning journeys that change how their HR teams perform.

At AIHR, we are looking for a full-time Senior Customer Success Manager / Learning Consultant (with Ed-tech experience) who will turn every learning initiative into a clear story of performance improvement and organization-wide impact. Join us and play a pivotal role in shaping the future of the HR industry!

About AIHR

Founded in 2016 with the mission to future-proof HR, the Academy to Innovate HR (AIHR) has become the world's market leader in online training for human resources (HR) professionals. We have a global customer base spread across 140+ countries, including companies like Unilever, Reckitt, Goldman Sachs, Philips, Deloitte, Nike, Heineken, and UBS. Our goal is to upskill and empower 1,000,000 HR professionals.

We are an international team of 100+ people, driven by excellence, innovation, and a hunger to grow in everything we do. We strive to provide the world's best courses and excellent support to our customers, while continuously optimizing every aspect of our work. With over 30 nationalities, our team is diverse, yet we all share a few traits: we're friendly, enthusiastic, and great team players.

As a fast-growing company, working at AIHR means taking on a lot of responsibility, with countless opportunities to develop yourself in new areas and to craft your own role.

Role and Responsibilities

As a Senior Customer Success Manager (with Ed-tech experience), you enable AIHR's largest B2B clients to run successful learning initiatives and build a culture of learning. At AIHR, we call this role Learning Consultant rather than Customer Success Manager, because your focus goes beyond account management. You act as a strategic advisor, guiding customers in designing and implementing learning journeys that drive measurable impact.

You own a dedicated portfolio of our largest and most complex enterprise customers, from onboarding to adoption, all the way to renewal. What does that look like in practice?

  • Strategic partnership: You build strong, multi-level relationships with senior stakeholders (CHROs, VPs and Heads of HR, Heads of L&D) and make sure AIHR stays aligned with their business objectives.

  • Joint Impact Plans: You diagnose customer needs and co-create a Joint Impact Plan that connects our learning solutions to their business goals, with clear metrics to show return on investment (ROI).

  • Enterprise onboarding and adoption: You onboard large customers and design the change management and communication strategy that embeds the AIHR platform in their learning culture.

  • Portfolio health: You take full ownership of your portfolio's health. You use the Customer Health Score in HubSpot to spot risks early and act before they turn into churn.

  • Commercial partnership: You co-own commercial goals with our Growth Account Executives. Your deep customer knowledge shapes the renewal and expansion strategy for your accounts.

  • Team excellence: You mentor other Learning Consultants and help develop the team's best practices and playbooks.

You are successful when your clients' learners show improved work performance, not just when they complete a program, and when AIHR's impact makes them want to grow the partnership. Ultimately, your client's success is your success. Your goal is to develop their learners into T-shaped HR professionals.

On a typical day

You arrive at our beautiful office in Rotterdam or Amsterdam, grab a coffee, and after a quick chat with colleagues, you fire up your MacBook to check your calendar. You start by reviewing your portfolio in HubSpot, our single source of truth, paying close attention to the Customer Health Score to prioritize your actions for the day.

Your morning starts with a Quarterly Strategic Check-in with the VP of HR at one of your key accounts. You present a clear story of their progress and ROI, using learning and engagement data you analyzed with the help of an AI skill. Afterward, you have a 1-1 with your manager, Emilie, to build a multithreading strategy for an account where you only have one champion. Later, you spend time with Dieter, one of our superstar SMEs, to plan a thought leadership session for your customer's HR leadership team.

After a delicious lunch in the office with the team, you dedicate time to a new enterprise client, Ahold Delhaize, documenting their business objectives to build their Joint Impact Plan and rollout communication strategy. You then join Jessica, our Growth Account Executive, to align on the commercial strategy for an upcoming multi-year renewal, so you show up as one team. Next, you sit down with a newer Learning Consultant to prepare a difficult conversation with one of their customers.

Before the day ends, you contribute to an internal project, sharing customer feedback about new features and improvements with the product team, including insights you summarized by feeding call transcripts into Gemini.

To wrap up the week, you join the team for a drink during our weekly activity, celebrating joint successes and getting to know new colleagues.


Who you are

Helping large clients roll out complex learning initiatives is nothing new for you. You've done it many times, and you know your value goes further. You are the strategic advisor senior HR leaders call first, because you know that when they experience impact with AIHR, they see real skill development, better performance, and a lasting change in their learning culture.

Furthermore, you have:

  • 7+ years of experience in a client-facing role, such as a (Learning) Consultant, L&D Professional, or Customer Success Manager, specifically within the Ed-Tech or E-learning industry;

  • A proven track record of managing a portfolio of large, complex enterprise accounts and prioritizing to maximize impact;

  • Demonstrable experience building and maintaining relationships with multiple senior stakeholders at the same account (multithreading), up to C-level;

  • Strong English proficiency, with the ability to discuss proposals, write clear copy, and push back on or challenge senior customers constructively;

  • A natural ability to ask insightful follow-up questions to diagnose core challenges and co-create solutions with clients;

  • Expertise in adult learning principles, change management, and designing effective L&D strategies for large organizations;

  • The ability to think commercially, identify growth opportunities, and connect HR initiatives to overall business performance and ROI;

  • Strong skills in using data from tools like HubSpot and Excel to derive insights and present a clear story of progress and value to executives;

  • Hands-on experience using generative AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude) for tasks like analysis, content creation, and workflow automation. This is essential;

  • A genuine desire to help develop colleagues and raise the capabilities of the whole team.

To set you up for success in this role, we are specifically looking for candidates with external-facing customer experience (not in-house L&D roles) and a background in education, e-learning, or ed-tech. We believe many skills can be learned on the job, but these experiences are essential. They provide the foundation you need to drive impact in our environment.

We offer

  • A key role in shaping the education of tens of thousands of HR professionals from all over the world through our courses;

  • Competitive, benchmarked compensation;

  • The opportunity to shape your own day-to-day work;

  • Regular growth talks and support to reach your career goals;

  • Flexible working hours and working-from-home arrangements after your onboarding;

  • A high degree of autonomy in a vibrant, result-driven, inclusive, and international team;

  • A key role in a fast-growing scale-up company;

  • A beautiful office right across Rotterdam Central Station (Millenniumtoren) and a brand new office in Amsterdam;

  • 26 paid holidays per year + 1 extra day for every year you work here + you can exchange any 2 public holidays for 2 other days of your choice;

  • Pension plan;

  • 5 mental health days per year;

  • Access to the OpenUp mental health platform;

  • Personal development budget, training, and we pay for the books you read;

  • All public transport expenses covered (NS Business Card);

  • MacBook + all other equipment you need to do your work;

  • Daily lunch prepared by a chef, weekly drinks, and fun team activities;

  • Free access to the office gym.

Get a taste of the AIHR experience and check out our AIHR Benefits Guide!

Apply for the job

Do you want to join our team as our new Senior Customer Success Manager / Learning Consultant (with Ed-tech experience)? Then we'd love to hear from you! You don't meet every single point above, but think you have what it takes? Please still apply! We are hiring for this role as soon as we find the right candidate.

P.S. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women tend to apply only when they meet 100% of them. We'd love to consider you and see if you could be a great fit.

title: Test Engineer
description:
Wij zijn op zoek naar een test engineer met een brede technische interesse die techniek graag combineert met organiseren en samenwerken. Hoe mooi is het om als eerste een installatie aan te zetten en te testen of alles werkt zoals bedoeld en voldoet aan de verwachtingen van de opdrachtgever? Je werkt met uiteenlopende systemen, zoals camerasystemen, branddetectie, luchtbehandeling, voedingsverdeelkasten, verlichting, netwerken en waterinstallaties. Kortom: een compleet technisch gebouw, waarbij jij helpt om alles goed en aantoonbaar werkend op te leveren.

Dit wordt jouw baan

Je brengt samen met de testmanager in kaart wat er getest moet worden, stelt testplanningen en -protocollen op en bewaakt de voortgang. Je bereidt onder andere FAT-, PAT- en iFAT-testen voor, zorgt dat de juiste mensen, systemen en componenten beschikbaar zijn en begeleidt de daadwerkelijke testuitvoering. Bevindingen leg je zorgvuldig vast en je bewaakt dat deze worden opgevolgd. Je hoeft daarbij niet vanaf dag één specialist te zijn in alle systemen. Je werkt samen met ervaren testmanagers, testcoördinatoren, engineers en technische specialisten en krijgt de ruimte om je inhoudelijk verder te ontwikkelen.

Meer bij Dura Vermeer

Dura Vermeer is een onafhankelijk familiebedrijf. En dat merk je. In hoe we samenwerken, naar elkaar omkijken en bouwen met oog voor de volgende generaties. Al sinds 1855 bouwen we aan Nederland, in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek. Onze onafhankelijkheid en lange termijn visie vormen daarbij de basis.

Met een omzet van € 2,6 miljard en ruim 3.700 collega’s behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Maar uiteindelijk draait het bij ons niet om die cijfers. Het draait om mensen. Om collega’s die samen werken aan projecten waar je trots op bent – iconisch én dichtbij – en bijdragen aan oplossingen voor maatschappelijke vraagstukken.

Onze ambities zijn groot. En die maken we alleen waar met betrokken mensen. Daarom investeren we in goed werkgeverschap en een werkomgeving waarin jij je thuis voelt. Waar je jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je uitspreekt. Zodat jij het beste uit jezelf haalt en samen met ons meer maakt.

Hier zit je op je plek

Je wordt onderdeel van de vakgroep Technische Installaties binnen het cluster Ontwerp van Dura Vermeer Infra Landelijke Projecten. Samen met circa 140 collega's werk je aan de grootste multidisciplinaire infrastructurele projecten van Nederland, zoals tunnels, bruggen, sluizen, energieprojecten, waterzuiveringen en hoogspanningsinstallaties. Binnen het project werk je nauw samen met collega's uit ontwerp, uitvoering en projectbeheersing. Je krijgt veel ruimte om richting te geven aan het testproces en kunt daarbij terugvallen op ervaren collega's en technische specialisten. Afhankelijk van het project werk je op locatie, vanuit een Dura Vermeer-kantoor of vanuit huis. Als eerste opdracht voorzien we een rol op het project Landstations, waarbij we de locatie realiseren waar de wind energie vanuit windparken op zee wordt omgezet naar het landzijdige nationale elektriciteitsnet. Je werk daarmee direct mee aan de verduurzaming van onze elektriciteitsvoorziening.


Dit breng jij mee

  • Een hbo / wo opleiding, bijvoorbeeld in elektrotechniek, werktuigbouwkunde, industriële automatisering of een vergelijkbare richting;

  • Een brede interesse in technische installaties en de motivatie om verschillende systemen te leren doorgronden;

  • Je kunt technische tekeningen en documentatie lezen of bent gemotiveerd om dit verder te leren;

  • Je werkt gestructureerd en kunt technische informatie vertalen naar een praktische aanpak;

  • Je communiceert makkelijk met verschillende partijen en vindt het leuk om techniek en coördinatie te combineren;

  • Ervaring met testen, commissioning, FAT/SAT of technische projectcoördinatie is een pré.

Why this role?

title: Afstudeerstage AI Adoption
description:
Wil jij helpen om AI van technologie naar dagelijks werk te brengen?

Bij HG geloven we dat technologie mensen sterker maakt. Daarom hebben we de afgelopen periode een stevig fundament gelegd voor AI binnen onze organisatie. Microsoft Copilot is geïntroduceerd, er zijn verschillende AI-initiatieven gestart en steeds meer collega’s ontdekken wat AI voor hun werk kan betekenen.

De volgende stap is opschalen. Want AI beschikbaar maken is één ding. Zorgen dat mensen het daadwerkelijk goed gebruiken, er nieuwe vaardigheden mee ontwikkelen en hun manier van werken aanpassen, is waar de echte transformatie plaatsvindt.

Als afstudeerstagiair AI Adoption help je ons om die volgende stap te zetten.

Je komt terecht in een internationale organisatie waar samenwerking, initiatief en nieuwsgierigheid centraal staan. Je begint dus niet vanaf nul. Je bouwt verder op wat er al staat en helpt ons te ontdekken welke aanpak nodig is om AI-adoptie verder te versnellen.

Je combineert onderzoek met praktijk. Je analyseert hoe AI wordt gebruikt, vertaalt data naar concrete acties, ontwikkelt en geeft trainingen voor verschillende AI-maturiteitsniveaus en helpt collega’s om AI steeds beter toe te passen in hun dagelijkse werk.

De exacte onderzoeksopdracht bepalen we samen, zodat deze aansluit bij jouw opleiding, interesses en afstudeereisen.

HG is een compacte, snelgroeiende en internationale organisatie waar je direct de impact van je werk ziet. Dit vraagt om eigenaarschap, initiatief en een pragmatische, resultaatgerichte houding. De cultuur is open en stimuleert het delen van ideeën, constructieve samenwerking en verantwoordelijkheid nemen. Alles wat we doen is gebaseerd op onze kernwaarden: Aim High, Be Brave, Be Connected.

Wat ga je doen?

Binnen HG zijn de eerste stappen in AI-adoptie al gezet. Er is dus een fundament om op voort te bouwen. Tijdens jouw stage help je ons om naar brede, structurele adoptie te gaan.

Concreet ga je onder andere:

  • Praktische en inspirerende Copilot-demo’s geven aan verschillende groepen medewerkers.

  • Bestaande adoptiedata analyseren en vertalen naar inzichten en concrete acties om gebruik en impact te vergroten.

  • Onderzoeken waar adoptie achterblijft en welke interventies kunnen helpen om medewerkers verder te brengen.

  • AI-trainingsprogramma’s ontwerpen en uitvoeren voor verschillende AI-maturiteitsniveaus, van collega’s die net beginnen tot ervaren gebruikers.

  • Trainingen, workshops, oefeningen en praktische hulpmiddelen ontwikkelen waarmee medewerkers AI direct in hun eigen werk kunnen toepassen.

  • De Copilot Academy op ons intranet verder ontwikkelen en actueel en relevant houden.

  • Medewerkers meenemen in de bredere AI-transformatie en concreet maken wat AI voor hun eigen werkzaamheden betekent.

  • Het AI Champions-programma ondersteunen en verder helpen ontwikkelen.

  • Feedback en behoeften van medewerkers ophalen en vertalen naar verbeteringen in trainingen, communicatie en andere adoptie-initiatieven.

  • Onderzoeken welke activiteiten daadwerkelijk bijdragen aan meer gebruik, betere AI-vaardigheden en waarde voor de organisatie.

Jouw onderzoek en werkzaamheden helpen HG om AI niet alleen beschikbaar te maken, maar daadwerkelijk onderdeel te maken van de dagelijkse manier van werken.

Je werkt rechtstreeks samen met onze AI Transformation Lead en hebt veel contact met collega’s uit verschillende afdelingen binnen de organisatie. Hierdoor krijg je een goed beeld van zowel de menselijke als bedrijfskundige kant van AI-transformatie.

Omdat HG actief is in meer dan 45 landen, werk je bovendien in een internationale omgeving waarin verschillende functies, perspectieven en niveaus van AI-volwassenheid samenkomen.

“We beginnen bij HG niet meer vanaf nul met AI. Er ligt een fundament en steeds meer collega’s werken ermee. De interessante vraag is nu: hoe zorgen we dat AI voor veel meer mensen écht onderdeel wordt van hun dagelijkse werk? Ik zoek iemand die het leuk vindt om daar samen met mij de volgende stap in te zetten.”
– Els Marchal, AI Transformation Lead

  • Je vindt het leuk om voor groepen te staan en anderen iets nieuws te leren.

  • Je vindt het leuk om trainingen, materialen en nieuwe manieren van leren te ontwikkelen.

  • Je durft initiatief te nemen en ideeën in de praktijk uit te proberen.

Ervaring met tools zoals Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT en Power BI is een pre. Belangrijker is dat je nieuwsgierig bent naar AI en enthousiast wordt van de vraag: hoe zorgen we ervoor dat mensen AI daadwerkelijk goed gaan gebruiken?

Wat bieden wij jou?

Wij zijn HG!

Bij HG, een toonaangevend Europees merk in specialistische reinigings- en onderhoudsproducten, geloven we dat een huis een plek moet zijn waar je zorgeloos kunt leven.
