title: Engineering Manager II, Cloud Security
description:
At Qualia, we've built the leading B2B real estate technology that transforms the home buying and selling experience into a simple, secure, and enjoyable process. Our SMB and Enterprise products bring together users from across the real estate ecosystem—homebuyers and sellers, lenders, title and escrow agents, and real estate agents—onto a single shared digital closing platform, providing greater clarity and transparency to real estate transactions. Today, through our business customers across the country, millions of consumers use Qualia to close on homes every year.

WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

Millions of consumersclose on homes through Qualia every year, which means our cloud carries wire instructions, identity documents, and nonpublic financial data at scale. Cloud Security owns the security of the infrastructure that platform runs on: our AWS accounts and organization, Kubernetes clusters, identity and access paths into production, the CI/CD systems that deploy to it, and the detection and response signal that tells us when something is wrong. The team works alongside Application Security, SRE, Platform, and InfoSec.

We're hiring a player-coach Engineering Manager to build and lead Qualia's Cloud Security team. You'll set the direction for how we secure AWS, Kubernetes, and the paths into production, hire the two senior engineers who'll do it with you, and stay close enough to the work to review a Terraform plan or an IAM policy yourself.

The mandate is to make the secure configuration the default one. That means guardrails, organization-level policy, paved-road modules that product teams adopt, and detection that catches drift and abuse in minutes. Where AI can take the first pass on posture findings, access reviews, or alert triage, you'll make that the normal workflow.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead and grow the team. Hire, coach, and set goals for Cloud Security engineers; own delivery against the roadmap
  • Own cloud security architecture. Set standards for AWS account structure, network segmentation, encryption, and workload isolation across our Kubernetes clusters
  • Run identity and access for production. Drive least privilege across human and machine identities: SSO into AWS, role design, just-in-time access, and secrets management
  • Ship guardrails as code. Service control policies, admission control, policy-as-code checks in CI, and hardened Terraform modules that stop whole classes of misconfiguration
  • Own posture management. Build our posture checks in-house, in Go and policy-as-code, across cloud resources and container images; turn findings into a prioritized, owned queue that burns down
  • Build detection and response. Partner with SRE on cloud-native detection (CloudTrail, audit logs, runtime signal) and lead the cloud side of incident response
  • Secure the delivery pipeline. Protect CI/CD, artifact provenance, and deploy credentials as production assets
  • Partner across engineering. Review proposals; represent Cloud Security in SOC 2 and customer security reviews

YOUR BACKGROUND THAT LIKELY MAKES YOU A MATCH

  • 7+ years in security, infrastructure, or platform engineering on production cloud systems, with 2+ years managing or leading engineers
  • Deep hands-on AWS security: IAM and Organizations, VPC design, sops, logging, and the services that carry sensitive data
  • Production Kubernetes security experience: RBAC, network policy, admission control, workload identity, and container image hygiene
  • Infrastructure-as-code fluency (Terraform or similar) and a record of shipping guardrails engineers adopted
  • You've built or scaled a cloud security function, or a major part of one, and can show what changed because of it
  • Strong written communication: you can write the architecture standard, the incident post-mortem, and the one-page risk summary for leadership
  • You measure impact by exposure removed and time-to-detect, and you can point to numbers
  • Experience in fintech, real estate tech, or another regulated, high-liability domain (Optional)
  • Detection engineering or DFIR background in cloud environments (Optional)
  • Hands-on use of LLMs or agents in a security workflow such as posture triage, access review, or alert enrichment (Optional)

THE TECH STACK YOU'LL SECURE

  • AWS (primary), some Azure, and limited GCP (Vertex AI)
  • Kubernetes and a microservice architecture, defined in Terraform and our infrastructure-as-code monorepo
  • Okta for workforce identity and SSO into AWS
  • NodeJS / TypeScript services, MongoDB, and an internal ClickHouse + Grafana security telemetry pipeline
  • Go for internal security tooling and detection services

We are a remote-first development organization that values flexibility in how our teams work. In addition to supporting fully remote roles, we have an office in Austin, with a hybrid option available for those who live nearby and prefer in-person collaboration.

While this role is based in Austin, Texas, we're open to exploring remote possibilities for qualified candidates.

WHY QUALIA

Qualia is made up of incredibly bright, mission-driven coworkers who are passionate about using technology to solve real-world problems—and we're growing quickly. In order to continue building an engaging and dynamic organization, we're committed to giving everyone the support they need to do great work.

Our benefits package is designed to allow our team members to be their best selves, both in and out of the workplace. In addition to comprehensive health plans, a 401k program, and commuter benefits, we prioritize family and personal well-being through professional development, parental leave, and a flexible time off policy. Qualia offers a robust online onboarding program to train new hires, biweekly all hands meetings, and a variety of internal virtual events to keep employees connected.

We believe diverse perspectives and backgrounds are critical to building great technology, and our goal is to cultivate an environment where people feel equally valued and respected. Yubico is a global leader in identity security and creator of the YubiKey, the original hardware-backed passkey. We are publicly traded on Nasdaq Stockholm; our global footprint includes headquarters in Stockholm, Sweden, Silicon Valley, California; and Singapore.

title: Analytics Engineer (AI) | Martech
description:
Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

GET TO KNOW US

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Analytics Engineer (AI) to our Marketing team in Brazil!

The Analytics Engineer (AI) is an embedded analyst position, a hybrid role combining data engineering, marketing data analysis, and applied AI skills. This individual supports the Marketing Analytics team by building and maintaining the data infrastructure that enables business teams to analyze campaigns and overall marketing performance, while also expanding that infrastructure to power AI-driven analytics tools.

You will join the Marketing Analytics team, working alongside an experienced Analytics Engineer who will be your closest technical reference. Responsibilities span data modeling, pipeline management, predictive analysis, and the design of machine-readable business context that makes AI agents accurate and trustworthy. This role collaborates closely with teams across the company (including Martech, Global Analytics, Product Development, and Sales Operations) to ensure data-driven insights effectively drive business growth.

This is a Remote – Brazil position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in Brazil.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Build and maintain the marketing data layer, developing pipelines that transform raw marketing sources into dimensional models (following Medallion architecture) and delivering clean, report-ready tables for downstream analytics.
  • Maintain and extend BI data models (LookML and/or dbt preferred) enriched with metadata, business context, and structured definitions that make them consumable by AI agents and natural language analytics interfaces.
  • Build reusable AI skills, tools, and workflows with guidance from senior engineers, empowering analysts and stakeholders to interact with governed data through natural language interfaces.
  • Establish AI quality assurance by running structured test cycles defined with the team to validate AI agent output accuracy, identify regressions, and maintain quality standards as models and data evolve.
  • Support the development of statistical and predictive models for marketing funnel metrics, and help maintain and operate the attribution models that measure channel and campaign contribution.
  • Ensure data reliability, governance, and documentation through continuous monitoring, data validation, adherence to responsible AI standards, and comprehensive version control in GitHub.
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams—including Martech, Global Analytics, Product Development, and Sales Operations—to ensure high-impact data-driven insights drive business growth.

Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

  • A technical problem solver with solid in-depth knowledge of Python and SQL, possessing the ability to write clean, production-grade data pipelines rather than one-off scripts.
  • An engineer well-versed in modern data architecture, familiar with data warehousing concepts, ETL/ELT workflows, orchestration tools (dbt, Airflow, or similar), and dimensional modeling.
  • A practitioner with hands-on experience in semantic layer tools (Looker/LookML strongly preferred; Tableau, PowerBI, or similar welcome).
  • A curious builder with hands-on experience in applied AI, including LLMs and agentic workflows (designing agent context, AI-assisted pipeline development, or LLM-based production tools).
  • A clear, collaborative communicator who enjoys working across both technical and non-technical stakeholders and is fluent in English to collaborate within a globally distributed team.
  • An analytical thinker with nice-to-have exposure to AI agent context design (glossaries, structured behavioral rules) and marketing analytics domain knowledge (funnels, attribution, CRM, growth).

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer, Ads Foundational Representations
description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com.

Location: Reddit has a flexible first workforce. Don't live near our office? No worries: you can work remotely from anywhere in the UK or the Netherlands.

The Ads Foundational Representations (AFR) team develops signals and representations of Reddit’s core entities (ads, posts, users, and so on), capturing the semantic, contextual, and behavioral information that Reddit Ads needs. We work on building embeddings to understand content and users' interests based on the content they engage with.

Our team has the potential to highlight one of Reddit's biggest differentiators: genuinely curated, high-quality, extremely relevant, and daily updated organic content. We are a Machine Learning/Data heavy team with a focus on the following areas:

  • Multimodal & Content Embeddings - Make sense of organic (posts, comments, subreddits) and promoted (ads, shopping products, their landing pages) text and media content by embedding them into a shared space.
  • Contextual and Behavioral Relevance - Working with Product & Data Science, establishing definitions of what ads are relevant to users and the content we show them next to, building metrics and fine-tuning embeddings to better reflect relevance.
  • Knowledge Graph Embeddings - Building representations for the Knowledge graph entities, e.g., intellectual properties/brands, to be used for high-precision targeting & business insights.
  • User Intent Modeling - Leveraging various techniques to introduce user representations based on the content they interact with: batch & real-time sequence modeling, LLM summarization, etc.
  • LLM-based Representations - Leveraging LLMs, VLMs, and foundational models to build complex representations of Reddit entities that improve ranking outcomes

The signals and features we create become a key piece in the Ads Delivery funnel, from targeting to the auction, as well as the Business Insights product and other advertiser-facing products such as Creative generation and optimization.

As a Staff ML Engineer, you’ll be in charge of setting the technical direction of multiple pillars the team owns. You will lead cross-functional ML projects end to end - from high-level business gap analysis to engineering execution.

Roughly 50% of your time will be spent on technical leadership and mentorship (driving strategy & designs, cross-functional collaboration, raising the quality bar), another 50% being individual hands-on work (data analysis & engineering, modeling & automation).

Responsibilities

  • Providing technical leadership and mentorship to MLEs in the team: driving designs & their review, establishing best practices in analysis, modeling and engineering, keeping the bar high.
  • Working closely with team/org leadership developing technical strategy for content-based embeddings & relevance for Ads.
  • Developing new or iterating on existing embedding models for advertising use cases, ranging from aggregation pipelines to two-tower architectures and sequence models.
  • Working with local and 3rd-party LLMs/VLMs: extract representations, develop evaluation methodologies, prompt tune and fine-tune large models to build state-of-the-art embeddings.
  • Building data processing and inference pipelines for the models we develop.
  • Qualitative and quantitative evaluation of the various features we develop, end-to-end experimentation from internal benchmarks to downstream recommender system offline metrics to online experiments.
  • Ensuring the reliability, scalability, and performance of the ML systems by writing automated tests, monitoring performance, and implementing best practices for model management.
  • Participating in modeling and coding reviews: You will review work by other team members and provide feedback to ensure that it meets the team's standards for quality and performance.
  • Collaborating with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions.

Required Qualifications:

  • 7+ years of hands-on experience with the full lifecycle of designing, training, evaluating, testing, and deploying industry-level models.
  • Demonstrated Staff-level technical leadership: mentoring engineers, driving standards and bar raising, leading complex cross-functional projects: from requirements, design to cross-team/functional alignment and execution without direct people-management authority.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts to different audiences, both verbally and in writing.
  • Strong track record of working on content rich NLP/CV problems at scale, and using embeddings as a tool to solve them.
  • Established data-driven approach for ML system development. Excitement about working with data and readiness to look behind the metric numbers.
  • Familiarity with the Ads domain and/or Search/Recommender systems.
  • Experience with mainstream DL frameworks: PyTorch or TensorFlow.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with our stack (Python, Pytorch, Airflow, BigQuery, Ray, k8s, kafka, GCP)
  • Tech leadership experience: mentoring junior engineers and leading complex projects.
  • Hands-on experience with using/fine-tuning/building LLMs.

title: Corporate & Integration Operations Associate
description:
Remote role based in Athens, covering mostly US East Coast hours (afternoons and evenings in Athens). Independent contractor engagement at $3,500–$4,500 per month (USD), depending on experience. As a contractor, you’ll invoice us monthly and handle your own taxes and social security contributions.

ABOUT 3Y HEALTH

3Y Health is building the operating system for healthcare practices, an AI-native platform that helps clinicians start, run and grow their practice. We work as a managed services organization (MSO): along with the software, our operations team runs the back office for the clinics we partner with, including billing, insurance and compliance. We currently serve applied behavior analysis (ABA) therapy practices and are expanding into other specialties. We're backed by over $200mm from Founders Fund, General Catalyst, SoftBank and 8VC.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We enter new markets by acquiring a foundational clinic for each specialty and region we go into, and we partner with independent clinics across the country. Every clinic adds entities, filings, contracts, staff records and deadlines that need to stay in order.

In this role, you'll own a set of our entities from start to finish. When we acquire a clinic, you'll carry out its integration plan: collect and file the records, prepare the filings, get staff ready for day one and follow up with everyone until each item is closed. Each deal comes with a detailed plan and timeline from the deal lead. Acquired clinics keep running largely as they do today until we bring them onto our platform, usually within a few months. Once a clinic is integrated, you'll keep its entity in good standing, alongside the existing entities you own.

You don't need experience in US healthcare. Every deal comes with a detailed checklist, and we'll teach you the US specifics. You need to learn fast, care about details and follow through. You'll work closely with our Corporate Development, Legal, Billing and HR teams in the US, and with a teammate in the same role.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Acquisitions

  • Work through each deal's integration checklist from before signing through the first months after close, keep the tracker current, and flag anything at risk of slipping

  • Document how the clinic runs today, such as scheduling, intake, referrals and billing handoffs

  • Check that each acquired entity is in good standing, and that its legal name and tax ID match across IRS, state, bank and payer records

  • Support our team and advisors on payer change-of-ownership notices, Medicare enrollment updates and credentialing checks

  • Map every payer's electronic payment setup (EFT/ERA) and each clinic's bank accounts, so our billing team can keep cash flowing through close

  • Prepare staff for day one: verify the employee roster, gather employment records for legal review, run license and exclusion checks, collect onboarding paperwork securely, and help get payroll, benefits and staff FAQs ready

  • Inventory each clinic's vendors, software and logins, collect business associate agreements (BAAs) for legal review, and track which systems switch to ours at close, later or not at all

  • Follow through after close on staff communication, moving patients of departing providers to remaining clinicians, lease and facility license items, and the former owners' transition commitments

Entity management and corporate operations

  • Keep the entities you own in good standing, primarily by managing our vendors: prepare annual reports, state registrations, IRS updates and other filings, and track them to on-time filing with our legal team

  • Maintain entity records, including formation documents, officers, registered agents and ownership

  • Prepare and submit provider and facility enrollments with state Medicaid programs and other public payers, and track them to approval

  • Make sure incoming mail for your entities is logged, routed and acted on, especially anything with a deadline

  • Prepare contracts from templates, route them for signature, and keep our contract management system and renewal dates current

  • Note what worked and what didn't, so our checklists get better with each deal

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 2–5 years in healthcare operations, practice management, credentialing or provider enrollment, or acquisition integration

  • A track record of managing many details and deadlines to completion

  • Comfort working with contracts, licenses and government forms. You read carefully and catch errors.

  • Strong spreadsheet skills, and quick to learn new systems

  • Excellent written and spoken English. Most of your work is with US teams, agencies and vendors, and most decisions happen in writing.

  • Comfort handling confidential information

  • High agency and low ego. You don't need to be chased, and you'll do the tedious work as carefully as the interesting work.

  • Based in Athens and able to work mostly US East Coast hours (afternoons and evenings in Athens)

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience in US healthcare, insurance or another regulated industry

  • Experience working with US companies or customers

  • Experience with corporate filings, contract administration or compliance work

  • Daily use of AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT to work faster

WHAT WE OFFER

  • A monthly fee of $3,500–$4,500 (USD), depending on experience

  • A long-term role at a venture-backed US company, working closely with leadership

  • Room to grow as we acquire more clinics and enter new specialties

ENGAGEMENT

This is a long-term independent contractor engagement with 3Y Health, not an employment contract. You'll need to be registered as a freelancer in Greece, or be willing to register before your start date. You'll be paid monthly in USD.

If you meet most of the requirements and the role interests you, we'd like to hear from you, even if you don't check every box.

title: Senior Growth Manager (Contract)
description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com.

Working as a Senior Growth Manager supporting Reddit’s International Community team, you will develop and execute initiatives that strengthen Reddit’s user and community ecosystems in the US and across international markets.

This position is open to candidates based in the UK or the US - East Coast.

This is not a marketing role. You will identify high-impact growth opportunities, design and execute experiments, and develop successful interventions into repeatable models that can be applied across markets. Your work may include building and scaling communities, increasing the supply of relevant content and contributions, reaching underserved audiences, and strengthening Reddit’s user experience.

The role combines growth strategy, hands-on experimentation, data analysis, and cross-functional influence. You will work closely with Product, Data Science, Marketing, and Community teams while maintaining the autonomy and entrepreneurial mindset required to scale successful initiatives to other markets.

Responsibilities:

  • User & Community Growth Strategies: Establish and execute comprehensive strategies to grow the user base and nurture communities.
  • Growth Experimentation: Design and execute growth experiments aimed at addressing gaps in content supply, community density, contribution, discovery, engagement, and user growth. Apply a creative, entrepreneurial approach by testing ideas quickly, learning from results, and iterating accordingly.
  • Scaling and Repeatability: Translate successful experiments into repeatable playbooks, processes, and recommendations that can be applied across markets. Determine which elements can scale broadly, which require local adaptation, and what operational or product support is needed to unlock broader impact.
  • Data & Performance Analytics: Monitor key growth and ecosystem indicators, including DAU, contribution, content supply, community health, and retention. Analyze performance trends, identify risks and opportunities, and establish clear measurement frameworks for experiments and scaled programs.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Partner with various internal teams to provide insights, shape priorities, and scale growth initiatives. Build compelling evidence through experimentation to influence cross-functional investment and product development.

Required Qualifications:

    • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
    • 7+ years of experience in user growth, product operations, or market expansion, with a demonstrated track record of executing growth initiatives at scale.
    • Strong entrepreneurial instincts, hands-on execution skills, and the ability to make progress independently in ambiguous or resource-constrained environments.
    • Data-driven and analytical mindset, with proficiency in Excel modeling, working knowledge of SQL, and experience creating scalable processes and automations.
    • Strong systems thinking, with the ability to distinguish between market-specific problems and growth opportunities that can be addressed through repeatable approaches.
    • Exceptional communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively and align cross-functional stakeholders across global teams.
    • Results-oriented mindset, strong attention to detail, and a bias toward execution.
    • Comfort balancing a portfolio of opportunities across the US and international markets and prioritizing based on potential impact, feasibility, and strategic relevance.

title: Lead Solutions Engineer
description:

Veriff's Solutions Engineering team works at the intersection of technology, customer experience, and commercial strategy. We partner with customers to understand their business and technical needs, navigate complex challenges, and demonstrate the value of Veriff's solutions. Working closely with Sales and Account Management, we help build strong customer relationships and support Veriff's growth.

The opportunity

We're looking for a Lead Solutions Engineer to lead our Solutions Engineering team in EMEA. You'll combine technical expertise, people leadership, and commercial thinking to support enterprise customers, strengthen collaboration across teams, and drive business results in the region.

You'll provide structure and direction to the team, improve how we work with customers and internal stakeholders, and help translate our go-to-market strategy into commercial success. This is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact in a fast-paced, growing technology company.

What you'll achieve in your first 3 months

  • Build a strong understanding of the Solutions Engineering team, its priorities, and Veriff's go-to-market strategy.
  • Establish relationships with key customers and internal stakeholders across the Americas.

What you'll achieve by 6 months

  • Deliver against key team KPIs and contribute to the commercial objectives for the Americas.
  • Establish clear ways of working across Solutions Engineering, Sales, and Account Management.
  • Become a trusted leader within the Americas organisation, supporting team development and building strong stakeholder relationships.
  • Improve the team's ability to support complex enterprise customers and drive successful commercial outcomes.

What you'll bring — essential

  • Leadership experience: Experience leading, coaching, or developing a technical, customer-facing team. You're comfortable setting direction, creating structure, and helping people perform at their best.
  • Technical acumen: The ability to understand complex technical concepts, engage credibly with technical stakeholders, and translate customer requirements into practical solutions.
  • Customer communication: Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to adapt your approach to different audiences and explain complex concepts clearly.
  • Commercial mindset: An understanding of how technical solutions support business outcomes, with experience partnering with commercial teams to support customer and revenue goals.
  • Stakeholder management: Experience building relationships across teams, influencing decisions, navigating pushback, and handling challenging situations constructively.
  • Operational excellence: A proactive, structured approach to managing priorities, improving processes, and working effectively in a fast-moving environment.
  • AI mindset: Curiosity about AI and its practical applications, ideally with examples of tools or solutions you've built or experimented with.

Nice to have

  • Experience in enterprise B2B SaaS, ideally within a startup or scale-up environment.
  • Experience working with large, complex enterprise customers and managing technical and commercial relationships.
  • Experience building or scaling a Solutions Engineering team or improving its processes.
  • Familiarity with identity verification, fraud prevention, fintech, or related technology domains.

Why Veriff?

Identity is the core of the digital economy. In this role, you aren’t just selling software; you are building the infrastructure that prevents fraud and enables global trust. You will have a direct, measurable impact on our expansion into the world’s fastest-growing markets.

We are the preferred identity verification platform partner for the world’s most innovative growth-driven organizations helping conveniently verify and safeguard users anywhere in the world. We support the broadest number of identity documents from nearly every country and territory in the world - and this is continually increasing! With a diverse team in the United States, United Kingdom, Spain, and Estonia, as well as robust backing and funding from investors including Accel, Alkeon, IVP, Tiger Capital, and Y Combinator, we’re dedicated to helping businesses and individuals build a safer and more secure world. We strive to be the benchmark for trust online, and we take pride in being a positive force.

When you join Team Veriff, we offer you the opportunity to have a real impact and advance your career, while looking after you along the way with a range of benefits designed with you in mind. Some of our favorites include...

  • Flexibility to work from home
  • Stock options that ensure your share in our success
  • Extra recharge days on top of your annual vacation
  • Extensive medical, dental, and vision insurance to ensure you’re feeling great physically and mentally
  • Learning and Development & Health and Sports budget that you are free to tailor to your own needs
  • Four weeks of fully paid sabbatical leave after reaching your 5th work anniversary

We are an Equal Opportunities employer committed to a diverse and representative team. Different opinions, perspectives and personalities push us forward. title: Senior Central Monitor
description:
Position Summary:

The Senior Central Monitor will play a key role in ensuring the quality and integrity of clinical trial data through centralized monitoring activities, statistical data review, and proactive risk management. This position involves leading the development of Risk-Based Quality Management (RBQM) plans, conducting study risk assessments, identifying study KRIs (in collaboration with Functional leads), performing ongoing centralized statistical monitoring, remote centralized data review, and facilitating monthly RBQM meetings. works independently and manages report review and issue escalation for more complex studies and/or portfolios of work. Further, the Central Monitor may mentor junior colleagues, and may support the development of processes, procedures and other documentation to ensure a high functioning team

Essential functions of the job include but are not limited to:

  • Lead Development of RBQM Plan: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and implement comprehensive RBQM plans tailored to each study's specific needs - including identification of critical data & process, definition of KRIs & QTLs and centralized monitoring approach
  • Study Risk Assessment: Conduct thorough risk assessments for clinical studies, identifying potential issues and developing mitigation strategies, in consultation with functional team leads and PM
  • Centralized Statistical Monitoring: Perform centralized statistical monitoring & data analysis on study data to detect anomalies, trends, and potential risks, ensuring data accuracy and compliance.
  • RBQM Meetings: lead facilitation of monthly RBQM meetings by supporting review of study data, documenting findings, action plans and coordination of data cleaning activities to support study deliverables
  • Data Quality Assurance: Ensure the highest standards of data quality and integrity through proactive monitoring and timely interventions.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with clinical operations, data management, biostatistics, and other departments to support proactive oversight and management and data cleaning for studies
  • Reporting: Prepare detailed reports and presentations on monitoring activities, findings, and recommendations for sponsors and study teams.
  • Operational Insights: Oversee operational study metrics, including data entry trends, SDV backlog, site health trending and proactively communicate issues to study team members to drive towards resolution & proactive remediation
  • Mentor and Support Junior Colleagues: Act as a mentor to more junior Central Monitors - sharing best practices, lessons learned, etc. to improve team performance
  • Sponsor Engagement and Communications: support discussions with Sponsors around risk management and proactive data cleaning

Qualifications:

Minimum Required:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in a relevant field (life sciences, statistics, data management, clinical operations) or relevant/equivalent combination of education, training, and experience
  • Minimum 5 years experience in clinical monitoring, clinical trial management or equivalent
  • Working knowledge of ICH GCP guidelines and the clinical development process

Other Required:

  • Highly effective oral and written communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with project team members
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills
  • Excellent written and spoken English, including strong grammar and scientific vocabulary skills
  • Ability to work in a team or independently as required
  • Strong understanding of RBQM principles and methodologies.
  • Demonstrated ability to learn how to extract pertinent information from protocols, electronic study data systems, clinical systems, dashboards, and to leverage these data to assess risk
  • Proficiency in statistical analysis and data monitoring tools.
  • Detail-oriented with strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Demonstrated experience with integrated risk planning & management
  • Ability to mentor junior team members

Preferred:

  • CRO experience as a Central Monitor

Skills:

  • Statistical analysis and data monitoring
  • Risk assessment and mitigation
  • Report writing and presentation
  • Collaboration and teamwork

title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
Who We Are

Inato is a Tech for Good company striving to bring clinical research to each and every patient, regardless of who they are or where they live. To do this, we’ve built an AI-powered platform that changes how pharmaceutical companies and doctors around the world collaborate to bring medical breakthroughs to patients. Leading companies and over 5,500 research sites rely on Inato to increase patient access, improve representation in trials, and deliver life-changing treatments to patients faster.

Drug development is a challenging, intellectually complex, and rewarding endeavor. We are a growing team of passionate pharmaceutical experts, software and AI engineers, professional services members, and many more—all bringing their unique perspectives to solve the challenges facing clinical research.

Inato is a recipient of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, Fierce Healthcare’s Fierce 15, and Built In's Best Places to Work 2025 and 2026.

🧑‍💻 The Role

We are looking for a dedicated and creative AI Engineer to join our team. As an essential contributor to our mission of transforming healthcare, you'll play a leading role in building AI-driven solutions that directly influence clinical research and, ultimately, improve patient care. We’ve already deployed multiple AI use cases in production, and your skills will be crucial in pushing the boundaries of healthcare AI.

💊 Responsibilities

In this role, you'll take on complex challenges that will stretch your abilities and creativity:

  • Choose and orchestrate the right models to process and analyze multimodal data

  • Design and implement cutting-edge RAG techniques to efficiently handle large medical documents and patient histories

  • Build agentic systems to revolutionize key aspects of drug development such as patient recruitment or site selection

  • Work closely with cross-functional teams (software engineers, product managers, data engineers) to seamlessly integrate AI into our platform

  • Implement robust and scalable pipelines that meet production-grade engineering standards

Here are some examples of projects you might work on:

  • Our prescreening tool: an app relying on the latest reasoning models and visual RAG to accelerate patient recruitment. It's already being used across hundreds of clinical sites to assess patient eligibility at scale. You may find more on this in our publication: https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.15374

  • Our site selection agent: an agentic assistant coupled with a mathematical optimizer to assist pharmaceutical sponsors in their search for efficient clinical sites and find the right mix of sites for every study

💊 Qualifications

  • Several years of engineering experience with machine learning, data science, or AI at the centre of your work, not alongside it.

  • You’ve shipped LLM-based features (OpenAI, Anthropic, RAG setup, agent setup, LLM observability tools etc.) that real users use, and you’ve lived with them afterwards: fixed them when they broke, iterated when they underperformed, watched how people actually used them.

  • Python proficiency

  • Strong problem-solving skills

  • Strong communication skills, oral and written, both English and French

  • Strong product mindset able to challenge the product roadmap directly with our CPO

  • Knowledge about LLM’s evaluation challenges

  • Ability to autonomously deliver clean and production-ready code

🤩 Good fits we see often

  • ML engineers and data scientists who moved into LLM work as it matured.

  • Researchers who moved into production.

  • Software engineers who went deep on AI and stayed there.

😕 Probably not a fit

  • your AI work has been research, prototypes or POCs with nothing shipped and maintained in production.

  • you’ve spent most of your career in software engineering and shipped your first AI feature in the last year.

Why Inato?

Our mission is to make clinical trials more accessible and inclusive. We value diverse backgrounds and experiences, bringing together industry veterans with fresh perspectives to advance the clinical trials industry.

Join us at Inato and be part of a team that’s making a real difference in healthcare.

💊 Benefits

  • Remote-first philosophy & flexible hours

  • Top-of-the-line equipment

  • Modern free health insurance (Benefiz)

  • Compensatory time off (RTT)

  • Lunch vouchers (Swile)

  • Gym membership (Gymlib)

  • Free books & learning material

As our Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer, you will own the maintainability and scalability of the infrastructure that powers Inato's platform. Reporting to Bastien, our CTO, you will split your time between projects that strengthen our infrastructure and run work that keeps it healthy.

Until now, infrastructure work has been a shared responsibility between all members of the tech department. Now that we have multiples teams, more complex services, and a rapidly growing volume of patient data and system integrations, we believe it's time for a dedicated position. This is a high-ownership, senior individual-contributor role: you will inherit a functioning system, and be responsible for bringing it to the next level.

Your success will be measured by the impact of your projects on product delivery, and your ability to prevent and solve production issues.

Responsibilities

  • Lead projects that improve the maintainability and scalability of our cloud infrastructure

  • Own day-to-day infrastructure operations, solving problems directly or making sure they are dispatched to the right team

  • Coach other tech team members on how to best leverage the capabilities of our cloud infrastructure

Qualifications

Must-have

  • 5+ years in a similar role (infrastructure, platform, SRE, DevOps)

  • Strong experience building and maintaining highly available cloud infrastructure environments using code, directly supporting product delivery

  • Deep understanding of Linux systems, containerization and orchestration

  • Solid networking fundamentals

  • Excellent communication, able to translate between technical and non-technical audiences

Nice-to-have

  • Experience with GCP

  • Experience as the first or sole dedicated infrastructure hire

  • Experience in a regulated or healthcare environment

Concrete project examples

  • Redesign our IAM model. Move us from ad-hoc, hand-managed permissions to a clean least-privilege structure managed as code, making access auditable, consistent, and easy to reason about as we scale.

  • Centralize our logging. Re-architect how we handle logs so everything flows into a single dedicated sink project, giving the team one reliable place to observe and debug across environments.

  • Bring our cloud costs under control. Build cost visibility and guardrails into our GCP footprint, surfacing waste, setting budgets and alerting, and making cost a first-class signal in how we run infrastructure.

Technical environment

  • Cloud: GCP, GKE, Cloud Run

  • Infrastructure-as-Code: Terraform

  • CI/CD: GitHub, GitHub Actions

  • Observability: OpenTelemetry, Axiom

See more on stackshare

Benefits

title: Mid-Market Customer Success Manager - EMEA (German speaking)
description:
About this Role

Hi, Denise here and I am the Head of Mid-Market Customer Success at Ashby 👋. Our team is passionate about shaping and scaling an exceptional high-touch customer experience across the mid-market segment. As we continue expanding we are thrilled to be hiring our next CSM in EMEA to help shape how we serve customers in this region, ranging from high growth start ups to public companies.

As a member of our Customer Success team, you will help us continue to grow our High Touch Mid-Market Customer Success function. In this role, you'll implement, train, and support the adoption of Ashby with customers across the region, partnering closely with a talented group of four CSMs on the EMEA Mid-Market team.

Ashby is designed to be powerful and flexible, allowing users to adjust it to their needs. This means that there is a lot to learn. You will become a product and domain expert in order to enable our customers to make the best use of Ashby to drive hiring excellence.

Role Requirements:

  • You have professional fluency in German and English and are comfortable leading technical conversations with customers in either language.

  • You have a strong track record of Customer Success experience in B2B SaaS (at least two years), supporting customers through the adoption and long-term optimization of complex technologies. You enjoy building trusted partnerships with customers and helping them realize measurable value throughout the customer lifecycle.

  • You’re experienced managing a book of ~60 mid-market customers, exceeding $1.5M in total ARR. You enjoy developing relationships across a broad set of stakeholders while supporting existing teams to drive adoption and retention

  • You have experience working closely with cross-functional stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, Product, and Operations.

  • You love becoming a product and industry expert and have experience doing this in a previous customer success role. You can create ‘Ah ha!’ moments by tailoring training and product walk throughs to address a customer’s specific challenges.

  • You’ve worked with technically complex products and show a strong curiosity to explore details and understand how things work.

You Should Apply If:

  • 📣 You demonstrate mastery of clear communication. You ask questions with precision and can explain complex concepts in simple terms. You avoid business jargon.

  • 🎧 You are a great listener. You see your role as providing the voice of the customer to internal stakeholders so we can ensure that our product roadmap delivers value.

  • 📊You enjoy working with a larger book of varied customers, and can effectively prioritise your time to make the biggest impact.

  • 🧩 You’re energised by learning and supporting a complex product. You enjoy diving deep into technical details, navigating advanced configurations, and data workflows, and you enjoy helping customers make sense of them.

  • 🧑‍🏫 You love to teach. Whether it’s a complex report to a very tenured data analyst, or a workflow to a brand new recruiter, who is new to SaaS tools, you see every teaching moment as an opportunity.

  • 🔍 Your peers describe you as detail oriented. You obsess over sending crisp follow-up emails, on time. You take pride in internal operations, like real-time CRM updates.

  • ⚡️ You move fast. You leverage tools/technology to maximize your time. You are at home managing a wide range of customers, and prioritizing effectively.

  • 🗺️ You're energized by an ever-improving work environment. Our team is growing, and continually iterating on processes - we live by our Operating Principle of "Implement Continuous Improvement"

  • 📊 You are always looking for ways to improve your work through data.

Why you shouldn’t apply:

  • If you tend to thrive with a smaller, more focused book of customers, this role likely isn’t the right fit. Our Mid-Market CSMs typically manage a book of 60+ customers, balancing personalized relationships with efficient, scalable support.

  • You're interested in managing customer accounts with infrequent and well-defined touchpoints (rather than excited by the fluidity required of early stage CS work)

  • You shine as an exclusively commercial CSM, motivated by variable compensation. While our team's north star metric is revenue retention, we focus on adoption and engagement as our leading indicators. For renewal negotiation and upsell, we have a lovely team of Contract Managers. As such, this role does not currently include variable pay, aligning with our strategy to hire product-oriented CSMs rather than adhering to the conventional Account Manager model.

  • You’re afraid of rolling up your sleeves. If the idea of getting in the weeds with a customer about the nuance between a time in process report and a time to hire report feels too granular, or project managing a workflow change for offer approvals feels “beneath you”, this job isn’t going to be for you.

About Ashby

We’re building the next generation of enterprise software, and we’re starting with a suite of products that help talent leaders, recruiters, and hiring managers run their hiring process significantly better. Learn more on our website: https://www.ashbyhq.com/.

We are well-funded and backed by great investors, including Y Combinator, Elad Gil and Lachy Groom. We publicly launched in October 2022 and are already working with thousands of amazing companies, including Opendoor, Plaid, Airtable, Snyk, Benchling and SalesLoft.

We’ve built an incredible team and exceptional product over the past few years, and we are truly just getting started. In short, this is the perfect time to join 🚀

Interview Process

Our interview process is thorough - we aim to ensure each person that joins the team is the right fit for Ashby and will provide ample information for you to assess if Ashby is the right fit for you. The process for this role is as follows:

  • Intro Call with Ashby Recruiting - 30 Minutes

  • Hiring Manager Interview - 45 Minutes

  • Take-Home/Presentation Interview - 45 Minutes

  • Panel Interview - 1 hour

    • Rather than a traditional panel interview with a large group, we structure our panel into two focused conversations. This gives you the opportunity to meet with multiple team members in a more conversational setting centered on specific topics, instead of a formal Q&A. You'll discuss how you approach problem solving, dive into a product complexity exercise, then wrap up with a quick closing call with the hiring manager.

Benefits

  • You’ll get the time to do things the right way; we put a lot of emphasis on high quality work and avoid quick hacks as much as possible.

  • 10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby —do it when you feel financially comfortable.

  • Unlimited PTO. Expect “Vacation?” in our one-on-one agenda until you start taking it 😅

  • Generous equipment, software, and office furniture budget. Get what you need to be happy and productive!

  • $100/month education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval.

  • Private medical insurance, dependent on your region.

Ashby provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

Ashby is committed to a fair and transparent hiring process. We confirm that this advertisement is for an active, existing vacancy within our organization. Please be advised that we may use artificial intelligence-driven tools to assist our recruitment team in screening, assessing, and selecting candidates for this position.

description:
Overview

At Piedmont Healthcare, you’ll love a shared purpose, be motivated to be your best, and be recognized for your contributions. Piedmont Healthcare leaders are in your corner and invested in your success. Our wellness programs and comprehensive total benefits and rewards will meet your needs for today and help you plan for the future.

Responsibilities

The individual in this position on behalf of the entire Piedmont System will be responsible for managing the administrative appeal of reimbursement claims denied by Medicare or Medicaid on the grounds that the medical coding was incorrect. These duties involve coordination of activities with the managers of coding at each of the Piedmont affiliated hospitals and physician practices as well as the Senior Director of Government Appeals. The incumbent must maintain a high level of understanding of DRGs and MS/DRGs. ICD-9-CM Official Guidelines for Coding and Reporting, American Hospital Association Coding Clinic guidelines, federal guidelines for coding Medicare inpatient records, state guidelines for coding Medicaid records, Utilization Review ("UR") regulations and Medicare guidelines regarding medical necessity, inpatient, outpatient and observation. In the context of managing the appeals, the incumbent will be responsible for resolving differences of opinions among coders as to the most appropriate code.The incumbent will be responsible for preparing the coding appeals; performing a detailed review, analysis and extraction of clinical and coding information from patient medical records and drafting effective narratives for Medicare and Medicaid appeals briefs in support of denied cases throughout appeals at all levels of the government appeals process. In addition, the incumbent will be qualified and available to testify in appeal hearing before an administrative law judge as an expert in medical coding.

description:

As a hands-on team leader and comprehensive strategic Human Resources business partner, the HR Director will drive, implement, operationalize, and follow-through on all HR activities and relevant people initiatives across the Latin America Region (LAR). They will play a crucial role in understanding business needs and developing change and talent management strategies to achieve outcomes that meet TNC’s organizational goals in support of its mission. The HR Director must be agile, responsive and resourceful, working to find solutions to the myriad issues that arise. Who We Are:

The Nature Conservancy’s mission is to protect the lands and waters upon which all life depends. As a science-based organization, we create innovative, on-the-ground solutions to our world’s toughest challenges so that we can create a world in which people and nature thrive. We’re rooted in our mission and guided by our values, which include respect for all people, communities, and cultures. Whether it’s career development, flexible schedules, or a rewarding mission, there’s many reasons to love life inside TNC. Want a better insight to TNC? Thanks to more than 1 million members, over 400 scientists, and the dedicated efforts of our diverse staff and partners, we impact conservation around the world!

Title: Senior Analyst, Digital Marketing Analytics

Location: Nashville, TN or Remote


Overview:

Asurion is seeking a curious, performance-driven Senior Analyst of Digital Marketing Analytics to join the team at our Nashville corporate office or remotely. This role sits in the marketing organization and will provide analytical/data support to digital growth initiatives led by the marketing and partner teams in a B2B2C sales model. You’ll own the analysis behind our digital marketing programs for some of our biggest partners: reading conversion funnels, spotting where they break, and recommending fixes across paid media, email, and web.

Success in this role requires data analytics expertise, creative problem-solving, strong communication skills, an ownership mindset, and demonstrated experience working with cross-functional teams.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for standard and ad-hoc reporting on performance of our digital marketing, organic, email, web properties and voice/chat channels
  • Analyze digital conversion funnels, identify where they break, and recommend improvements to growth marketing, paid media, and email teams
  • Support ad-hoc and exploratory analyses of key partner initiatives, tests, and emerging growth opportunities, helping to identify opportunities and provide data-driven recommendations
  • Produce succinct reports highlighting results and key insights of digital programs using a combination of business intelligence tools (e.g., Power BI) and Excel
  • Help define KPIs and develop requirements for measurement planning, tagging, sourcing digital data across platforms, including web analytics, DSPs, websites/apps, etc.
  • Help evolve measurement and attribution approach, triangulating performance across client platform data and internal data sources
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams and partner teams to ensure we can define and effectively measure customer and business success to effect positive change
  • Stay up to date with AI technology, effectively leveraging LLMs, automation, and alerting to improve productivity and enhance insights generation

What You’ll Bring to The Team:

  • 2-4 years of professional experience in marketing analytics, including digital funnel measurement and paid media performance
  • BA/BS in data analytics, information systems, internet technologies, marketing, business, or a related field preferred; relevant data/analytics certifications and/or equivalent hands-on experience will also be considered.
  • Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities with excellent attention to detail

  • Experience working with Amazon data through platforms such as Amazon Ads or Amazon Seller Central strongly preferred
  • Experience measuring digital funnel, cross channel attribution, and initiative performance via web analytics platforms (Google/Adobe Analytics), digital A/B testing experience preferred
  • Experience working with subscription model performance analytics preferred
  • Experience working with customer segmentation or audience data is a plus

Why Asurion?

Simply put, Asurion helps people stay connected. We are a privately held company which enables us to focus on long term customer and client value. We provide over 290 million consumers around the world with simple, intuitive technology advice to help them get the most from their devices; support to fix their issues and connectivity crisis, and device protection to ensure they receive a replacement or repair. When a product is missing or simply doesn't work properly, Asurion’s 17,000 employees are focused on solving the problem with people and processes operating 24 hours a day, seven days a week, speaking six languages, and working across any device, platform, or provider. By partnering with leading retailers, mobile carriers, and pay-tv providers, Asurion helps make customers lives a little easier and their technology a lot more amazing.

title: AI & Data Architect
description:
Company Overview

Voted #1 EHR by PCMag, WRS Health delivers fully integrated, cloud-based EMR and practice management solutions. We support physicians through continuous enhancements to our products and services, including EHR, practice management, marketing, patient coordination, and billing.

Job Purpose and Role

We are seeking a highly skilled AI/Data Architect to design and manage the data infrastructure that supports reporting, advanced analytics, and AI applications across WRS Health. This role will work closely with AI Engineers, developers, and business stakeholders to make healthcare data accessible, reliable, secure, and ready for use in machine learning and large language model (LLM) applications.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and maintain scalable data architectures and pipelines that support reporting, analytics, and AI applications.

  • Define data models, storage strategies, and integration patterns for structured and unstructured healthcare data.

  • Build and maintain pipelines to collect, clean, transform, and validate data from clinical, financial, operational, and marketing systems.

  • Partner with AI Engineers to define data requirements and prepare datasets for model development, fine-tuning, and evaluation.

  • Design the data foundation for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), including document processing, embeddings, vector storage, and retrieval.

  • Establish shared data interfaces and APIs that enable AI Engineers to integrate LLM capabilities into EHR applications.

  • Manage data storage and retrieval for patient records, IoT, genomic, microbiome, and government datasets.

  • Support healthcare interoperability using FHIR, HL7, JSON, XML, C-CDA, NCPDP, and X12 standards.

  • Design and manage AWS data and analytics infrastructure supporting QuickSight, SageMaker, Bedrock, and Amazon Q.

  • Develop reports and dashboards that provide actionable insights across departments.

  • Establish data quality checks, lineage, versioning, and documentation so datasets and AI outputs can be traced to their sources.

  • Implement access controls and appropriate handling of sensitive healthcare data across analytics and AI workflows.

  • Collaborate with AI Engineers on MLOps and LLMOps requirements, including reproducible data pipelines, monitoring, and deployment integration.

  • Monitor and improve infrastructure reliability, retrieval performance, processing speed, and operating costs.

  • Translate stakeholder needs into technical specifications and maintain architecture documentation.

Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field.

  • Proven experience in data architecture and engineering, including infrastructure supporting AI or machine learning applications.

  • Strong expertise in data modeling, database design, and scalable data processing.

  • Strong proficiency in Python and SQL, with experience building data pipelines and API integrations.

  • Experience designing solutions using relational databases, data warehouses or data lakes, and vector databases.

  • Hands-on experience with data preparation for LLM applications, including document processing, chunking, embeddings, and retrieval-augmented generation.

  • Understanding of how data quality, retrieval design, and source context affect LLM response accuracy and relevance.

  • Experience with AWS data and AI services, including familiarity with QuickSight, SageMaker, Bedrock, and Amazon Q.

  • Familiarity with MLOps and LLMOps practices, including dataset versioning, evaluation datasets, and production monitoring.

  • Working knowledge of LLM APIs and frameworks such as LangChain or LlamaIndex to collaborate effectively with AI Engineers.

  • Understanding of data governance, privacy, security, and access controls for sensitive healthcare information.

  • Experience with FHIR, HL7, JSON, XML, X12, and healthcare data exchange is highly preferred.

  • Experience with visualization tools such as QuickSight, Tableau, or Power BI.

  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

  • Healthcare industry experience and familiarity with HubSpot are a plus.

A Day in the Life

You’ll review pipeline health and data quality, collaborate with AI Engineers to prepare datasets and improve data retrieval, and build data models, integrations, and dashboards. Throughout the day, you’ll work with stakeholders to resolve data issues and ensure the infrastructure supports reporting and AI application needs.

Success Metrics

  • Pipeline reliability, data freshness, and data quality meet agreed targets.

  • AI Engineers receive validated, traceable datasets within agreed timelines.

  • Retrieval accuracy, response times, and infrastructure costs meet project targets.

  • Reporting and data automation reduce manual work and support stakeholder adoption.

If you are passionate about building the data foundation for practical healthcare AI solutions, we encourage you to apply.

Because cannabis cannot be certified USDA Organic under current federal law, the Certified Kind program provides an independent, third-party verification modeled after internationally recognized organic standards. Through rigorous inspections and accountability, Certified Kind cultivators demonstrate their commitment to producing cannabis with respect for both people and the planet.

Everything we do starts with our living soil, which is an active ecosystem of beneficial bacteria, fungi, and other microorganisms that naturally cycle nutrients, support vigorous plant growth, and promote resilience. Rather than simply feeding the plant, we cultivate a thriving soil food web that allows each cultivar to fully express its unique cannabinoid and terpene profile while producing healthy, vibrant plants. By working with biological systems instead of relying on synthetic inputs, we produce cannabis that is true to its genetics and rich in the compounds that make every cultivar unique.

We proudly offer flower, pre-rolls, concentrates, vaporizers, and edibles through our family of brands, including FRX, Anthos Organics, Common Citizen, Local Edibles, and Cannarocks. Every product reflects the same care, consistency, and attention to detail that goes into every harvest.

title: Senior Financial Analyst, Commercial Finance
description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we're shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, security and more. And we're doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren't beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About this team and role:

Mozilla Finance partners with business units to drive strategic resource allocation and financial insight across our product portfolio. Our team of analysts supports revenue and cost ownership across Search, Advertising, Firefox, Marketing, and New Products.

We're adding a commercially-minded analyst will cover three areas: New Products (revenue and costs for B2B and SaaS-type initiatives), Ads revenue analysis in partnership with our Data Science team, and Marketing cost including labor and program spend reconciliation through close.

Beyond ownership of those areas, you'll contribute to the team's broader push to standardize how we plan and report. This role reports to the Senior Director, Finance and works alongside three senior analysts.

The right person has done commercial finance in a B2B environment, is comfortable working with data scientists, and doesn't wait to be asked before making something better.

What you'll do:
  • Own New Products financials: Maintain the forecast for New Products revenue and costs (labor + program spend). Validate inputs, reconcile actuals through close, and document drivers. Maintain position-level detail on how labor is forecasted and reported
  • B2B Financial Modelling. Once a B2B deal or New Products initiative is live, maintain an ongoing financial model, updating commercial assumptions as the business evolves. Keep operating view current as actuals come in and support with ad hoc scenarios as needed.
  • Support Ads revenue analysis. Partner with Data Science to conduct deep-dive research into Ads revenue trends, building the analytical frameworks and recurring views that help the business understand performance and pursue growth. Translate findings into clear insights.
  • Marketing cost reconciliation. Support reconciliation of Marketing program spend, coordinating with the Marketing cost lead to ensure accuracy through close and flagging issues before they compound.
  • Drive team standardization and reporting: Help build shared processes and templates so results can be presented as a unified view.
  • Be a reliable business partner. Field data and reporting questions, anticipate stakeholder needs, and communicate complex information in terms non-finance partners can use — escalating items that call for a broader partnership discussion.
  • Apply AI and automation to recurring work: Identify opportunities to reduce manual effort across forecast, close, and reporting cycles.
What you'll bring:

Core Experience

  • 3–5 years of experience in commercial finance, B2B finance, FP&A, or a comparable analytical finance role, including hands-on work through a full budget and forecast cycle with close and variance analysis.
  • B2B commercial experience required. Familiarity with revenue modeling, deal economics, or partner, SaaS, or subscription revenue models in a B2B context.
  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or another quantitative field, or equivalent experience.

Technical Skills

  • Advanced spreadsheet and financial modeling skills. You care about formula cleanliness, auditability, and accuracy.
  • Experience with enterprise planning tools (Pigment, Adaptive, Workday, etc.) and accounting systems (NetSuite preferred).
  • Grounding in accounting fundamentals, including accruals and the monthly close cycle.
  • Comfort working with data science or analytics teams. Able to interpret analytical outputs, ask the right questions, and translate findings into financial terms.
  • Experience with revenue analysis or commercial modeling, including reconciling actuals to forecast in a multi-product or multi-channel environment.
  • Interest in applying AI, automation, and systems thinking to reduce manual effort in recurring finance work.
  • Ability to balance multiple competing priorities and cycle deadlines without loss of accuracy.

Communication & Collaboration

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain a variance, a revenue trend, or a forecast assumption clearly to a non-finance audience.
  • Experience building effective working relationships across functions. You know when to loop people in, can adjust how you present depending on who's in the room, and back your points with both numbers and context.
  • Ability to distill complex detail into structured summaries that business partners and senior stakeholders can act on.
  • Positive attitude, intellectual curiosity, and the drive to learn a new business quickly.
Nice to have:
  • Experience in B2B SaaS revenue analysis, digital advertising, and search monetization
  • Familiarity with revenue reconciliation or commercial reporting in a multi-product environment
  • Experience building automations or AI-assisted workflows within a Finance context, or the drive and resourcefulness to learn.
  • Experience with BI tools, SQL, Python, Power Query, or other data querying and programming languages.
Success Factors

You will likely be happy and productive in this role if you…

  • Possess an ownership mentality. You get things done accurately with minimal oversight, proactively flagging risks to timelines.
  • Have low ego and high flexibility. You approach problems with your opinion on the best solution, but can accommodate and adjust to differing viewpoints.
  • Are resourceful. You identify alternative solutions and resources to continue progress.
  • Learn new businesses fast. You ask the right questions, connect dots quickly, and build credibility with stakeholders through understanding what drives their results — not just the numbers.
  • See process gaps as opportunities. You spot inefficiencies and fix them without being asked. By the end of your first year, New Products is running on a clean forecast model, the team has at least one shared reporting process it didn't have before, and you've made the Ads revenue picture meaningfully clearer.
What you'll get:
  • Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team
  • Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)
  • Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together
  • Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday
  • One-time home office stipend
  • Annual professional development budget
  • Quarterly wellbeing stipend
  • Considerable paid parental leave
  • Employee referral bonus program
  • Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country)

About Mozilla

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging

Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission. We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons of all sexual orientations, gender identities, and expressions.

We will ensure that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, as appropriate. Please contact us at to request accommodation.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race (including hairstyle and texture), religion (including religious grooming and dress practices), gender, gender identity, gender expression, color, national origin, pregnancy, ancestry, domestic partner status, disability, sexual orientation, age, genetic predisposition, medical condition, marital status, citizenship status, military or veteran status, or any other basis covered by applicable laws. Mozilla will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics or any other unlawful behavior, conduct, or purpose.

HR Management

Employee Relations

title: Amazon PPC Specialist
description:
Role Summary

Alpha Lion is looking for an Amazon PPC Specialist to be the performance engine behind our paid and organic visibility on Amazon and Walmart. You'll own the marketing levers available on the marketplace — PPC campaigns, listing conversion, deals and promotions, and alignment with our DTC campaigns — and make sure every dollar of ad spend is tracked, tested, and optimized with precision. Your work will drive efficient, scalable growth and profitable revenue across our marketplace channels.

Responsibilities

  • Build, launch, and optimize Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display campaigns on Amazon and Walmart to hit target ACOS, TACOS, and ROAS goals.
  • Use automation tools (such as Scale Insights) and bulk file operations to manage bids, rules, and keyword changes efficiently across the full catalog.
  • Run search term analysis, negative keyword mining, and keyword harvesting to sharpen targeting and cut wasted spend.
  • Improve listing conversion and organic ranking through structured A/B tests, content updates, and keyword strategy, working closely with our creative team.
  • Plan and execute deals, coupons, and promotions, keeping them in sync with DTC launches and hero product pushes.
  • Deliver weekly performance reports and post-event recaps that come with insights and recommendations, not just numbers.
  • Help build out Walmart advertising, applying what works on Amazon while adapting to the differences between platforms.

What Success Looks Like

  • You consistently hit or beat ACOS and TACOS targets while growing ad-attributed revenue quarter over quarter.
  • You run a self-sustaining PPC system, with automation handling the routine so you can focus on strategic improvements.
  • Your structured testing lifts conversion rates and improves organic rank on hero products without a proportional increase in ad spend.
  • Promotions go live on time and perform at or above forecasted lift.

Who You Are:

  • You have an extreme eye for detail. You catch keyword cannibalization, bid errors, and budget pacing issues before they hurt performance.
  • You think in systems: you document what works, build templates, and create repeatable processes.
  • You treat PPC as a business lever, not a task list, and connect every ad decision to revenue, margin, and brand outcomes.
  • You take ownership. When a metric trends the wrong way, you flag it and come with solutions, and you meet every deadline without reminders.
  • You play to win. You're not satisfied with "running ads" — you want to outperform the category and beat competitors.
  • You communicate proactively, sharing trends, risks, and wins without being asked

Experience & Skills:

  • 2–4 years of hands-on Amazon PPC management, with direct ownership of ad budgets and performance targets.
  • Proven experience with an ad automation tool (Scale Insights, Pacvue, Quartile, or Perpetua) for automation rules, bid management, and bulk optimizations.
  • Strong command of the Amazon Advertising console and Amazon CRO: A/B testing with Manage Your Experiments, keyword research (Helium 10, Data Dive, or similar), and listing optimization.
  • Experience planning and running Amazon promotions: lightning deals, coupons, best deals, and Prime Exclusive Discounts.
  • Strong analytical skills in Excel or Google Sheets, and a clear understanding of TACOS and contribution margin and how ad spend connects to profitability.

Nice to have:

  • Experience managing PPC for supplement, health and wellness, or CPG brands on Amazon (regulated categories a plus), ideally on high-revenue accounts in a DTC environment.
  • Exposure to Walmart Connect, and an Amazon Ads certification.

Why Alpha Lion:

Alpha Lion is a fast-growing, performance-driven brand focused on helping people unleash their Superhuman potential. We are building scalable systems, raising the bar on execution, and creating long-term competitive advantage in our category.

This role offers the opportunity to work on high-impact initiatives, learn rapidly, and grow alongside a company that values ownership, curiosity, and results. If you’re excited by optimization, experimentation, and building systems that scale, Alpha Lion is a place where your work will matter.

Application Process

  • Apply: Submit your resume + a brief note explaining why you’d crush it in this role.
  • Screen: TA team reviews for skills and cultural alignment.
  • Cultural + Behavioral: In this step, you will take a personality assessment to see how you will perform in the role, then review it on a call with a cultural specialist here.
  • Interview: Conversations with the hiring manager and team.
  • Final Round: Case study or work simulation (role-specific).
  • Decision & Offer: We move fast — typically within 2–4 weeks.

Compensation:

We believe in competing at a high level — and that includes how we approach pay. This is a remote-first role, open to candidates anywhere in the U.S.
